chapters.title: Chapter 2351: It felt... dangerous.
paragraphs: Just as Zylarith was sure of his victory—
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
It happened.

Nux released the only force that had not failed him ever since the battle began, his physical strength, and this time, he released his strength in every single direction, tearing every speck of Chaos Energy around him as he freed himself.
Zylarith’s body scattered as well and appeared a few meters away from him.
This time, the pleased look on his face had disappeared and was replaced by a frown.
Something did not make sense here.

He had broken Nux’s physical body time and time again and he had made healing impossible. With the state his body was in, it should have been impossible for him to exert any physical force whatsoever, then how...
How did he do it...?
How did he manage to exert a physical forcethisstrong...?
Zylarith questioned inwardly, his mind started looking for answers and soon, he found it.
This time, he did not attack Nux immediately, he could see it as well.
His attacks did not matter, the boy seemed to have an unlimited source of power, so he needed to find that source first and destroy it altogether.
Zylarith then began to observe the space he was in—

It was an empty void, there was no ground beneath them, no sky above them. Far away, there were some small asteroids drifting through the darkness, some were whole, some were cracked, some had already been twisted by Chaos and now floated in strange shapes that made no sense.
Even farther away, faint stars burned quietly, some were real, some were still forming, then, Zylarith’s eyes fell back on Nux.
He was floating in the middle of the void, covered in blood.
His body was broken beyond repair, his Laws were overpowered, he was outclassed, but even then, he was standing tall, prepared to continue the battle.
"You are far more durable than you should be."
Suddenly, Zylarith commented with a strange calm as he raised his arm and black-purple chaotic energy gathered around his fingers.
Nux didn’t say anything, even now, he was trying to come up with a way to defeat Zylarith and somewhere, in the corner of his mind—
He was thinking of... undoing his domain and ending the battle.

Nux wasn’t a fool, he could see that he was close to defeat. Chaos was too strong of a power, it had influence over basically everything he did, so much that against it, none of his Laws were working.
The only advantage he did have, his Physical Strength, was completely useless since Physical attacks simply did not work on him.
He had... no way to hurt him...
And the worst part?
"It will take too long for me to break your body,
So let me shift my target."
Zylarith was getting close to the truth.
No, he was already there.
The moment Zylarith said those words, Chaos moved, but this time, it did not rush towards Nux, it passed around him and spread into the void.
Nux didn’t show any reaction on his face, his mind however, was now tense.
The violet-black Chaos seeped into the dimension, it touched the floating asteroids, the stars drifting away in space, then, it seeped into the deeper laws of Nux’s Universe—
Yes, Chaos had started to corrupt his very existence—
His Universe.
And Nux could feel the effect almost instantly, the Chaos Energy continued to seep into the very being of his Universe and started its corruption, it didn’t just affect the Dimension they were in—
It was affecting... Nux’s Main Universe.
The Universe where his wives and children were. If this continued, then considering the almost infinite amount of Chaos Energy this being had, with time—
He would manage to corrupt his entire Universe and... take control of it.
Yes, his entire Universe, not just the dimension he created just now, and if that happened, Zylarith would be able to travel wherever he desired within his Universe.
The moment Nux thought about it, his eyes turned colder instinctively. He tried to hide it, but it was already too late.
Zylarith noticed it.
"There it is."
He commented as more and more Chaos Energy spread, seeping into Nux’s Universe at an even faster rate.

Space stretched in places where it should have stayed still, Time pulsed unevenly, Light dimmed, Darkness felt weaker, Creation started producing broken shapes, Destruction failed to erase the wrongness, Life and Death started to lose meaning, Balance tilted and could not return and Chaos...
Chaos was growing at a rate far higher than what should have been possible.
Nux’s Universe—
It was being disrupted.
And the instant Zylarith realized how quickly all of it was happening, how weak the Universe’s resistance was to his moves—
He realized the truth.
"I was right."
He nodded.
"Your Universe is young, young to the point it hasn’t even developed yet. It has no resistance to me. In here, I can do whatever I please and the Universe isn’t mighty enough to stop me.
This is why it is doing the only thing it can do to resist me.
Strengthening you.
Beyond what should be possible.
It is supporting you with everything it has, it is keeping you standing when your body should have long given out.
But the thing is—"
Zylarith paused for a moment, his purple eyes shined with strong amusement and superiority as he glanced at Nux.
"I have no need to stick to expectations.
I have no need to constantly attack you, allowing the Universe to focus all its powers on one entity and fight back.
All I need to do is...
Attack your Universe instead.
I will weaken your already weak Universe, corrupt it with Chaos, and directly take control over it, hence controlling your and your wives’ lives.
And you know the most exciting part?"
Zylarith looked at him with a wide grin on his face and—
"As I do all this—
There is nothing you can do to stop me."
He declared as he extended his hands and the Chaos Energy around him became even denser, seeping even deeper into Nux’s Universe, to its very foundation.
Nux’s golden eyes shined with intense hatred as he watched Zylarith devour and corrupt his creation, his... self.
It washis.
He couldn’t allow someone else to take it.
Hisgreedwould not allow that.
That was when Nux took a step forward and something in him just... snapped.
He could end this battle anytime he wanted, but he wouldn’t, Zylarith Chaosveil would not leave this place alive.
Nux swore it in his heart and as he continued to walk forward—
His body began to... heal.
Not through the Law of Life, but through theweightof his own existence.
Zylarith noticed him, he noticed the rate at which his wounds were healing and that made him frown.
Was the Universe supporting him again? Even now? When he was directly attacking it?
That didn’t make sense.
Universes, as young as they may be, were selfish entities, it would abandon even its strongest warrior if it meant it could protect itself.
Then why...
Why was his Universe so hell-bent on... keeping him standing?
Zylarith couldn’t understand, but at this point, it didn’t matter, once he read Nux’s memories, he would get all the answers anyway—
For now, all he needed to do was to crush the seed that was developing.
He waved his hand, countless purple-black blades dashed towards Nux, he raised his hand, commanding the space around him to stop the blades.
"Do you not get tired of making the same mistake again and again?"

Zylarith questioned as he shook his head with disappointment. The Space around Nux twisted, the Blades that should have stopped were now closer, ready to cut him into pieces. Nux didn’t give up, he slowed the time, Zylarith shook his head again and the ’Sequence’ broke.
The Blades reached Nux before they finished moving, stabbing his body from all directions.
Nux’s blood scattered into the void.
"That was disappointing."
Zylarith commented, his Chaos Energy began to seep into Nux’s body, making its messy state even worse.
But this time—
Something was different.

This time, when all this was happening, when Nux was clearly losing, something about how he looked at everything that was happening to him, to the Chaos Energy around him, something about that... unnerving calm in his eyes...
It felt... strange.
It felt... dangerous.
Something that made even Zylarith frown.
The Infinity of Chaos did not wait, he waved his hand and more and more Chaos seeped into Nux’s body and his Universe, both at the same time—
But suddenly—
The Space and Time around Nux twisted and he disappeared.
Zylarith tried to stop him, he took control over the Time and Space Energy with a sigh—
"You have already used this trick befor—"
But this time, before he could complete his words—
Nux was right in front of him.
And—
He punched.
BOOOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 2352: I was right to choose you, Zylarith Chaosveil.”
paragraphs: BOOOOM
Nux punched.
Again, a physical punch couldn’t hurt Zylarith, his body simply scattered and reformed a few meters away, this time however, he wasn’t as calm as usual.
Instead—
He stared at Nux with a mix of confusion, surprise and... fear.
This shouldn’t have happened. He had already corrupted the Time and Space around him, he shouldn’t have been able to get near him but...
He did.
And before Zylarith could make any sense out of it—
The Time and Space around Nux moved again, he, once again corrupted it, this time for sure but—
Again, Nux stood right in front of him and—
He punched again—
BOOOOOOOM
Once again, his body scattered into hundreds of violet-black fragments, each flying in different directions.
But this time—
Nux didn’t let those fragments reform as easily as before—
This time, his eyes followed every single one of those fragments clearly.
That was when the Energy of Balance moved around Nux, but this time, something was... wrong.
It was Energy of Balance but... it wasn’t...
It was something so strange that even Zylarith, a being who was once called the strongest, couldn’t make sense of it.

Not that he was given the time, because the moment Nux activated this strange Energy of Balance, Zylarith’s scattered Soul fragments froze for a small instant, then, every single fragment cracked at the same time.
Zylarith reformed far away and—
"AAAAAAGGGGGHHHHHHHHH!!!"
He screamed.
A scream so loud that it shook the entire Dimension.
The once strongest Infinity, screaming in agony as his form flickered violently.
Nux watched it all with his cold, golden eyes shining intensely.
"So it works."
A small, cruel, dangerous smile appeared on his face. Zylarith looked at him, his purple eyes flared with intense anger and pain.
An absurd amount of Chaos Energy gathered around him, cause and effect were twisted again. The punch that had landed was erased, the moment Nux had reached Zylarith was removed.
Reality changed according to Zylarith’s desire, so the wound on his Soul should have disappeared, the pain should have disappeared but—
It did not.
Zylarith’s eyes widened in shock.

Nux watched him from a distance, he didn’t attack, not out of mercy or a fake sense of superiority, but because he wanted to observe everything that was happening and understand how what he was doing was working.
"I see."
He nodded to himself, noting down something he did not mention.
On the other hand, Zylarith, with his body still quivering in pain, slowly raised his head and now, his eyes were different.
The amusement and interest were gone.
Now, there was only anger.
That was it.
The playing time was over.
Now, Zylarith was going to take this seriously.
The Chaos around him became denser, this time, Zylarith did not affect mere surface-level Energies like Time and Space, now—
He went a level beyond.
Now, he started corrupting...
Ideas.
Concepts.
Or... Meaning.
Nux didn’t understand it, he didn’t have to, he simply appeared right in front of Zylarith and punched.
But this time—
Zylarith did not dodge, instead, he changed the very concept of punch, before it even arrived, the attack carried the memory of failure.
To avoid that, Nux’s body moved on instinct, he shifted his fist to the side, to ’correct’ the punch and he missed.
All on his own.
Nux frowned, even now, he didn’t understand what just happened, but he didn’t give up, he tried again, this time, his punch was even faster, he even wrapped it with Death, to inflict pain, but...
Before the punch could even land, it missed its ’Meaning.’
Nux stood right in front of Zylarith with his hand extended out like a fool, he looked like he had forgotten why he was here in the first place.
That was when Zylarith raised his finger and—
Nux’s wounds changed, the cuts on his chest deepened, not because Zylarith attacked them again, but because they weremade to believethey had always been that deep.

His broken ribs remembered never being whole, his torn muscles remembered being torn from the beginning, his blood remembered flowing wrongly, his nerves remembered agonizing pain as their natural state.
"Khhrrkkkkk!!!"
Nux coughed out blood again, his eyes were red from the extreme pain he was in. Zylarith brought his face right next to Nux’s and—
"This is Chaos."
He began, this time, there wasn’t a hint of amusement in his voice, there was only cruelty.
"It is not random destruction.
It is Contradiction."
Nux’s right arm twisted into a shape it shouldn’t be in, for a moment, it was alive, then it died, it was broken, healed, existing, erased, all at once.
"Gguuhhh!!"
Nux groaned in pain, but this was only the beginning.
His chest was torn open and healed again and again, his heart was made to beat and stop at the same time, his skin was burned and untouched, his blood was frozen and flowing in different directions—
All at the same time.
Every single thing ruined Nux’s body in a way that shouldn’t be possible and as he groaned in agonizing pain he had never experienced before—
"A Reality that is not loyal to itself."
Zylarith’s words sounded again.
Nux gritted his teeth, he used the Power of Creation, trying to create new flesh, and it happened, new flesh formed, new bone grew, but—
"Creation is structure."
Zylarith smiled, purple chaos touched the new parts Nux had just created and—

They twisted at impossible angles too, Zylarith made it so the old and new parts began to fight each other, Nux’s body was being destroyed by his own power, leaving him no choice but to destroy what he had created with the Power of Destruction.
But—
"Destruction is purpose."
Zylarith commented.
The Destruction twisted.
Instead of erasing the ’corruption’, it strengthened it. Purple marks appeared all over his chest and arms, almost as if Chaos was taking over his body.
It was useless.
Nux could see it as well.
He had tried it before too, but his understanding of Laws was too weak to go against Zylarith. It didn’t matter what Law he used, Zylarith could simply corrupt it all and use it against him.
Even now, as he tried to use Death directly on his Soul, Zylarith simply waved his hand and—
"Death is conclusion."
He declared as Chaos wrapped around Death.
The Death Law twisted.
Conclusion became... birth.
The black energy split apart and bloomed. Zylarith’s Soul shivered, then pieces of him separated.
One became two.
Two became ten.
Ten became a hundred.
Hundreds of Zylarith’s Soul fragments appeared around Nux.
Some looked human, some had no faces, some had too many eyes, some were only mouths, some were only hands, some were only black-violet smoke with a smile inside them—
But every single one of them was Zylarith.
A complete Zylarith.
And...
All of them attacked at once.
Chaos came from every direction.

One attacked his chest, another pierced his back, one tore open his face, another wrapped chaos around his arm, trying to erase the very idea that the arm belonged to him, trying to amputate him permanently.
Nux’s blood scattered all over the place and—
CRACK
The dimension he created cracked.
Yes, Nux’s very Universe was being torn and the first to be affected by it was the dimension he had created.
Zylarith’s corruption was getting stronger, his fragments surrounded him like an army of dead Gods, then, his true form appeared behind them and—
"Do you understand now?"
All of them spoke at the same time.
"This is why the Four of them came together."
He explained.
"This is why, even when I was dead, even when I was at my weakest, those Four never stopped looking for me.
They knew—
I may be at my weakest, but I amstillthe Strongest."

Zylarith declared, the Chaos Energy around him had now begun taking control over his surroundings, the Dimension they were in was already falling under Zylarith’s control and it was only a matter of time before Zylarith used this dimension to make his way towards Nux’s Main Universe and take control over it as well.
And while he did all that—
While he prepared to win—
Nux stood still, with his head down.
His body floated silently in the void.
He was wounded, surrounded and bleeding in a way that shouldn’t even be possible, his Universe trembled, screaming at whatever it was that was happening.
He could see it too.
It was over.
But then—
"Heh."
Nux laughed.
It was a low, hollow laugh that should have been inaudible, especially with all the Chaos around but—
Despite that, the laugh echoed throughout the void and that made Zylarith frown.
Something about Nux... didn’t feel right.
Nux then raised his head, this time, there was no frustration, anger, or pain in his eyes, there was only acceptance.
He looked at his dimension that was now broken, his Laws that were twisted beyond normal, the wounds on his body—
At the battlefield that made absolutely no sense.
And then—
He smiled.
"I see.
I was right to choose you, Zylarith Chaosveil."

Every single thing ruined Nux’s body in a way that shouldn’t be possible and as he groaned in agonizing pain he had never experienced before—
"A Reality that is not loyal to itself."
Zylarith’s words sounded again.
Nux gritted his teeth, he used the Power of Creation, trying to create new flesh, and it happened, new flesh formed, new bone grew, but—
"Creation is structure."
Zylarith smiled, purple chaos touched the new parts Nux had just created and—

They twisted at impossible angles too, Zylarith made it so the old and new parts began to fight each other, Nux’s body was being destroyed by his own power, leaving him no choice but to destroy what he had created with the Power of Destruction.
But—
"Destruction is purpose."
Zylarith commented.
The Destruction twisted.
Instead of erasing the ’corruption’, it strengthened it.
Purple marks appeared all over his chest and arms, almost as if Chaos was taking over his body.
It was useless.
Nux could see it as well.
He had tried it before too, but his understanding of Laws was too weak to go against Zylarith.
It didn’t matter what Law he used, Zylarith could simply corrupt it all and use it against him.
Even now, as he tried to use Death directly on his Soul, Zylarith simply waved his hand and—
"Death is conclusion."
He declared as Chaos wrapped around Death.
The Death Law twisted.
Conclusion became... birth.
The black energy split apart and bloomed.
Zylarith’s Soul shivered, then pieces of him separated.
One became two.
Two became ten.
Ten became a hundred.
Hundreds of Zylarith’s Soul fragments appeared around Nux.
Some looked human, some had no faces, some had too many eyes, some were only mouths, some were only hands, some were only black-violet smoke with a smile inside them—
But every single one of them was Zylarith.
A complete Zylarith.
And...
All of them attacked at once.
Chaos came from every direction.

One attacked his chest, another pierced his back, one tore open his face, another wrapped chaos around his arm, trying to erase the very idea that the arm belonged to him, trying to amputate him permanently.
Nux’s blood scattered all over the place and—
CRACK
The dimension he created cracked.
Yes, Nux’s very Universe was being torn and the first to be affected by it was the dimension he had created.
Zylarith’s corruption was getting stronger, his fragments surrounded him like an army of dead Gods, then, his true form appeared behind them and—
"Do you understand now?"
All of them spoke at the same time.
"This is why the Four of them came together."
He explained.
"This is why, even when I was dead, even when I was at my weakest, those Four never stopped looking for me.
They knew—
I may be at my weakest, but I amstillthe Strongest."

Zylarith declared, the Chaos Energy around him had now begun taking control over his surroundings, the Dimension they were in was already falling under Zylarith’s control and it was only a matter of time before Zylarith used this dimension to make his way towards Nux’s Main Universe and take control over it as well.
And while he did all that—
While he prepared to win—
Nux stood still, with his head down.
His body floated silently in the void.
He was wounded, surrounded and bleeding in a way that shouldn’t even be possible, his Universe trembled, screaming at whatever it was that was happening.
He could see it too.
It was over.
But then—
"Heh."
Nux laughed.
It was a low, hollow laugh that should have been inaudible, especially with all the Chaos around but—
Despite that, the laugh echoed throughout the void and that made Zylarith frown.
Something about Nux... didn’t feel right.
Nux then raised his head, this time, there was no frustration, anger, or pain in his eyes, there was only acceptance.
He looked at his dimension that was now broken, his Laws that were twisted beyond normal, the wounds on his body—
At the battlefield that made absolutely no sense.
And then—
He smiled.
"I see.
I was right to choose you, Zylarith Chaosveil."

chapters.title: Chapter 2353: Law of Anomaly.
paragraphs: "I see.
I was right to choose you, Zylarith Chaosveil."
Nux commented as he looked at Zylarith with an unsettling calm.
"What do you mean?"
Zylarith frowned.
All this while, he was under the assumption that Nux chose him because he believed he was the easiest target and while that was true to some level—
Nux had another motive.
A motive he hid even from his wives because he understood how dangerous it was.
"You control Chaos."
Nux began.
"Chaos is... Contradiction."
Zylarith didn’t say anything, those were his words and they were correct. That was what Chaos was.
Nux smiled at his confused expression and—
"You see, I am somewhat of a Contradiction myself."
"What...?"
Zylarith frowned in confusion, Nux however, did not explain any further. He just looked around him.
The unstable Reality, the incorrect Space, the Time that did not flow in order, the entire battlefield that did not make sense and he—
He... accepted it all.
The battlefield was no longer his.
It was filled with Contradictions.
And that was what he wanted in the first place, of course, the initial and safer plan was to devour him and get what he wanted through his memories—
But—
A few minutes into the battle were all Nux needed to understand how unrealistic that was.
He couldn’t defeat Zylarith Chaosveil, he was the strongest Infinity for a reason, he was... far more fearsome than anything Nux or even Azriel had predicted.
So why continue the battle?
When he knew he couldn’t win, why fight at all?
Because...
Nux, as he was right now, couldn’t defeat Zylarith Chaosveil.
But—
Nux himself was no ordinary being.
He was the only being who comprehended all Primordial Laws, the only being who managed to create an independent Universe, the only being who could make the Impossible... possible.
Or in other words—
An Exception.
Or...
A Contradiction.
The Anomaly.
The only being in the entirety of the Multiverse who had comprehended theLaw of Anomaly.
A Law that... shouldn’t even exist in the first place...
But it did.
Because Nux Leander did.
The problem however, was something different, something that Nux only kept to himself. While he did manage to form an absurd Law like the Law of Anomaly, he couldn’t make... progress in it.
How could he?
The Law itself had no definition, no prior records, no related Energies that one could understand to deepen his understanding of it.
It was an entirely independent Law and Nux had no way to strengthen it.
Or at least...
That was what he initially believed, but as he learned more about the Universe, as he learned more about Sharnoth and through her, he learned about what sort of existence his own Father was—
He had an idea.
Zylarith was wrong.
Chaos was not Contradiction, it was... the de-structuring of... structure. Even Chaos followed a fixed set of rules.
At best, it was... the closest thing to Contradiction.
And Nux—
His Law of Anomaly was the True Contradiction.
And because of that, all this while, as Zylarith attacked him, as Zylarith played around with him like he was a toy, he observed.
He observed Chaos, how it ruined his surroundings, his own body, how it spread disorder while being within order and...
He learned its pattern.

Nux Leander was no normal being, he had stopped being ’normal’ a long time ago and while most, even Zylarith believed that his strongest point was his physical body, Nux and his wives knew how false that was—
Because it wasn’t just Nux’s body that was reinforced by thousands of worlds he had devoured, his brain was too.

Nux’s strongest power was his mind, a mind that had seen the Universe from the perspective of thousands of Worlds, a mind that had a deeper understanding of the Universe, even compared to the Infinities. After all, the Infinities only saw the World through their own limited perspective—
But Nux?
He had observed the Universe through hundreds of thousands of different perspectives.
For a being like him, comprehending an impossible Law while facing the most difficult battle in his life was not impossible—
And that was exactly what he had done.
He, using Zylarith Chaosveil’s Chaos as a foundation, strengthened his understanding of the Law of Anomaly and now—
He was ready.
His Golden Eyes shined with an incomprehensible light, Zylarith didn’t like the look on his face, so he moved—
One of his fragments rushed at him, another broke the Space under his feet, taking away his footing, making it so he lost his balance but Nux—
He stood still, then, he grabbed Zylarith’s Soul Fragment by his neck.
"What...?"
Zylarith widened his eyes in disbelief.
This shouldn’t be possible, Nux shouldn’t have been able to touch his physical body, but he did and he crushed it.
His Soul Fragment scattered, it should have been able to reform a few meters away, but the next second—
The scattered mist... burned.
Zylarith’s Fragment was... burned out of existence.
"AAAGGGGHHHHHHH!!!"
Zylarith screamed, feeling the pain of a piece of his Soul being torn apart.
Nux didn’t show any reaction, he just looked at another Fragment that had corrupted the Future and was projecting his current self to attack him.
He grinned, then, he looked into his eyes, almost as if he was trying to read his mind and—
He punched in a random direction, or at least it looked random, but about five seconds later—
"AAAAAGGGGHHHHH!!!"
Zylarith screamed again, the Fragment that didn’t even exist was forcibly torn out of existence, another piece of his Soul was erased.
Then, Nux placed his hand on his own wounds, his chest was torn open and refused to heal, so he used the Power of Life, not to heal, but to give the Wound a... form, a shape.
Something with edges, something that... could be touched.
Then, Nux grabbed his own wound and... he threw it.

The red-black wound flew through the void like a blade and struck one of Zylarith’s fragments, the fragment split open, this time, Nux didn’t manage to erase it out of existence, but that wasn’t his goal anyway.
Nux’s wound was gone, his chest was healed.
"That is not how Life works."
Zylarith couldn’t believe the absurdity he just saw.
"It isn’t."
Nux nodded, already standing in front of another one of his fragments. His golden eyes then shined and—
"That is howIwork."
He grinned as he destroyed another one of his fragments.
Then, Nux looked at him and stepped forward. The Power of Creation moved, but Nux didn’t create any weapons, he created... a way to Zylarith’s True Self.
A way that shouldn’t even be possible since Zylarith had long since destroyed the Space surrounding him but—
It didn’t matter.
Nux created a way nonetheless and the next second, he stood right in front of him.

The rest of Zylarith’s fragments tried to stop him, moving all at once, Nux used the Power of Destruction, Zylarith changed it, making it so the instant Nux tried to use it to destroy his fragments, he would be the one to take damage but—
Nux was no longer using Laws how they were supposed to be used.
He was using them in a way that... shouldn’t exist.

And since that way never existed in the first place, it had no order, no pattern Zylarith could use to ruin it, making it impossible for Zylarith to stop Nux’s Laws from doing whatever absurdity he was planning.

The Destruction Energy destroyed the Fragments’ escape, the void around them locked. When the Fragments realized it, they tried to scatter, they failed. Zylarith tried to erase his fragments’ meaning, but even that failed.
And Nux—
Now that all of Zylarith’s Fragments were right in front of him, a big, wide grin appeared on his face.
Zylarith tried to stop him but Nux punched.
BOOOOOOOOOM
And in an instant—
Every Soul Fragment was forcibly shredded out of existence and—
"AAAAAGGGGGGGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Zylarith screamed in agony he had never once felt before.
Nux didn’t waste time, he had the clear advantage, so he moved forward, prepared to end it, but Zylarith, even as he suffered through the pain of half of his Soul vanishing from existence—
"DO NOT THINK THIS IS OVER!!!
I WILL NOT FALL!!
NOT TO A CHILD LIKE YOU!!!"
He screamed, the rage behind his voice was so terrifyingly loud that the entire dimension shook violently. For a moment, Nux’s own body shook as he looked at Zylarith in surprise.
He had erased more than half of his Soul, he had countered all his moves, Chaos held no power over either his Laws, or his body—
The battle should have been over.
Then...
What was with that scream?
What was with that familiar feeling he just felt...?
He thought about it for a moment, and then he found the answer—
This wasn’t his own memory—
It was the combined memories of more than five hundred worlds that he devoured—
The memory of a single instance that the entire Universe felt, all at the same time, during the Great War of the Five Infinities.

When Zylarith, who was being overwhelmed by four Infinities, used a move that the entire Universe felt the brunt of, the move that not only injured every single Infinity present there, but also killed the weakened Infinity of Eternity.
Zylarith’s trump card, a move he only used once in the history of the Universe and right now—
He was using it again.

chapters.title: Chapter 2354: Chaos Origin: The First Contradiction.
paragraphs: Zylarith’s trump card, a move he only used once in the history of the Universe and right now—
He was using it again.

He raised both his hands, the empty void inside Nux’s Universe grew darker. Violet-black light leaked from the cracks that had formed in his Soul Form after Nux’s relentless attacks, his smoky body flickered as if it could no longer support itself.
But his eyes were different.
His intense violet eyes glared at Nux with intense hatred, the Chaos around him became far denser than anything Nux had seen.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
Nux’s dimension trembled violently, as Zylarith’s Chaos penetrated deeper, into the Laws like Time and Space, into Concepts, Meaning, Ideas, all the way into...
The Truth.

His Soul Form grew larger in presence, the void around him bent in odd shapes, as if it could no longer hold him properly, his white hair scattered into countless strands of light, his smoky robes fluttered dramatically and then—
"Chaos Origin."
The words echoed throughout the dimension and for a moment—
Everything stopped, even Nux.
And then—
"The First Contradiction."
Zylarith’s words echoed again and reality itself broke.

Nux’s eyes widened in shock, for a moment, he was in his Dimension, then he found himself moved to his Universe, then to the Main Universe, then to the Worlds that no longer existed, then he was nowhere, then everywhere at the same time.
His mind was overloaded with so much information at the same time that for a moment, even he felt dizzy.
But it wasn’t over.
He looked at Zylarith, he was in front of him, then behind him, then he was wounded, then untouched, then dead, then alive, then he was never harmed at all.
Nux’s previous attacks had landed, but they had also missed, the wounds on Zylarith’s Soul existed, but they also never existed, victory was close, yet victory was impossible.

Life and death no longer stood against each other. Creation and Destruction became the same thing. Light revealed nothing. Darkness hid everything by showing it clearly. Balance tilted and remained balanced. Time moved forward, backward, sideways, and nowhere. Space had distance and no distance.
And Chaos...
It thrived.
Every truth contradicted itself.
And every single one of these contradictions was real.
"What the..."
Nux stood there like a fool who had no clue what was happening, his Law of Anomaly thrived where things made no sense, that was correct but...
This was worse!
Nux clenched his fists, trying to think of something but—
CRACK
His right arm broke, then it healed, then stayed broken, then it returned to normal.
And the pain?
The pain from all these versions struck at once.
He gritted his teeth in pain.
He tried to move, to get away from whatever this place had become, but there was nowhere to move, every direction led to the same place, and thatsame placewas not there. Space was ruined entirely.
Other Primordial Energies were no different, every single one of them was ruined beyond what even Nux could understand, only Chaos thrived—
And no matter how strong Nux was, it was simply not possible for him to overpower Zylarith when it came to Chaos.
"Khrrrkkk!!"
Nux coughed out blood, his body that he had barely healed cracked again, that same torturous cycle he had been through repeated, only this time, it was far more agonizing.
"Gaaarhhhh!!"
Nux groaned in unbearable pain, his skin came off his body, revealing his bloodied state that he couldn’t recover from.
And it wasn’t just him, his entire Dimension, his entire Universe was being attacked and corrupted at the same time.
This was Zylarith’s last-ditch effort to come out on top.
And as the Infinity of Chaos saw his attack work, as he saw his child shivering in pain while his Universe was being forcibly taken away from him—
He grinned.
"Do you see it now?"
He spoke, his voice coming from every single direction.
"This was Chaos... before there was order to oppose it.
This is whyIwas the strongest.
This is why they feared me, even today."

Zylarith’s eyes burned brighter, Nux tried to move, but in this space he did not understand, even a simple action like that made his body scream in agony as it was crushed by a pressure he couldn’t comprehend.
"Kharrrkkkk!!"
He coughed blood again.
Zylarith raised one hand, he could practically see Nux’s current image being superimposed by the previous Infinity of Eternity right before he killed her, just like he was going to kill him.
"Now disappear."
He declared and—
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
All the Chaos collapsed towards Nux, every truth... turned against him.
He was strong, so his body broke down.
He resisted, so his body surrendered.
His Laws protected him, so they now wounded him.
He was alive, so he was now... dead.
He existed, so now he...
He was erased.
Yes, for one moment, Nux nearly vanished, his golden eyes dimmed, his universe began to crack, preparing for its end but then—
He smiled.
"A World where even the Truth itself is a Contradiction."
He commented with a blood-covered face as the shine in his eyes returned.
"Good."
He praised, the broken reality trembled, almost as if it was screaming for his help.
Nux moved his fingers, his body was still in a state of contradiction, dead, alive, whole, broken, present, erased, all at the same time, his Universe was still cracking, his Laws had all failed—
But this time, he did not fight it.
He simply observed the world around him and...
He began to understand it.
"What...?"
Zylarith couldn’t believe what he was seeing.
The First Contradiction was not an attack with ridiculous attack damage, it was more of a... battlefield control move.
A move that dismissed every single Primordial Energy, except Chaos, it basically made the Battlefield unlivable, even for the Infinities, even for Zylarith himself.
The only reason he was even alive and well was because of the dense Chaos Energy protecting him from the damage.
But Nux...
He did not have the Chaos Energy protecting him, even if he could use Chaos, all the Chaos around him now belonged to Zylarith and he had no control over it whatsoever.
He should have no way to protect himself.
Even the Infinity of Eternity didn’t.
Heck, even the other Three Infinities barely got out of this alive by using the Infinity of Eternity’s death as a cover to attack him from behind.
Then...
Why was he still alive!?
Why was the dense Chaos not crushing his body into something even his wives would not recognize?
Why?
What was happening?
Why, despite being surrounded by deadly energy, was his body... healing?
"W-What are you doing!?"
He asked, stuttering in shock and horror for the first time in his entire life.
He did not have any answers.
And the worst part?
There was nothing he could do.

While the Chaos Energydidprotect him, it was only because he had gathered a dense amount of it around him, it was like a cage he couldn’t get out of, or else the environment outside would tear him apart too.
He couldn’t use the Chaos Energy to attack him either, because he needed Chaos in its densest form to protect him, using even a little bit of it risked exposure—
Which, with half his Soul already gone—
He couldn’t risk.
So Zylarith could only watch.
"I ASKED WHAT IS IT YOU ARE DOING!?"
And scream.
But Nux did not answer—
He kept his eyes closed, his body broke, healed, died and lived, all at the same time, but the pace at which all of it was happening was... slowing down.
Almost as if...
Nux had begun to control it.
Which, again, should not have been possible but...
That was exactly what Nux was doing—
Doing what should have been impossible.
Because that was who he was—
An Anomaly.
And that was when it happened.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
Everything around Nux exploded, the dense Energy of Chaos scattered, the effect of the First Contradiction was still there but...
It wasn’t because of Zylarith.
It was because Nux decided to keep it there.
Finally, he opened his eyes, and with a new, stronger clarity, he looked at Zylarith and—
"Thank you, Father."
He smiled.
"W-What...?"
That was the only thing that came out of Zylarith’s confused, dumbfounded mouth.
Nux’s smile widened.
"You helped me understand my own power.
I will not forget that.
In return—
I will only torture your soul for the next trillion years, instead of Eternity."
"YOU DARE!?"

Zylarith raised his voice, showing his strong side even now, but inwardly, his mind was in utter shock, even now, he couldn’t understand how this bastard was moving inside the First Contradiction so freely.
But what he could understand was that the First Contradiction was no longer hurting Nux, instead, it was strengthening Nux, while trapping him in his own cage.
So Zylarith decided to remove it, to return everything back to normal, so at the very least, he could regain his movement.
With that thought in his mind, he waved his hand while his mind tried to come up with ways to deal with the monster in front of him.
But—
Nothing happened.

sentences.text: Zylarith’s trump card, a move he only used once in the history of the Universe and right now—
He was using it again.
He raised both his hands, the empty void inside Nux’s Universe grew darker.
Violet-black light leaked from the cracks that had formed in his Soul Form after Nux’s relentless attacks, his smoky body flickered as if it could no longer support itself.
But his eyes were different.
His intense violet eyes glared at Nux with intense hatred, the Chaos around him became far denser than anything Nux had seen.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
Nux’s dimension trembled violently, as Zylarith’s Chaos penetrated deeper, into the Laws like Time and Space, into Concepts, Meaning, Ideas, all the way into...
The Truth.

His Soul Form grew larger in presence, the void around him bent in odd shapes, as if it could no longer hold him properly, his white hair scattered into countless strands of light, his smoky robes fluttered dramatically and then—
"Chaos Origin."
The words echoed throughout the dimension and for a moment—
Everything stopped, even Nux.
And then—
"The First Contradiction."
Zylarith’s words echoed again and reality itself broke.

Nux’s eyes widened in shock, for a moment, he was in his Dimension, then he found himself moved to his Universe, then to the Main Universe, then to the Worlds that no longer existed, then he was nowhere, then everywhere at the same time.
His mind was overloaded with so much information at the same time that for a moment, even he felt dizzy.
But it wasn’t over.
He looked at Zylarith, he was in front of him, then behind him, then he was wounded, then untouched, then dead, then alive, then he was never harmed at all.
Nux’s previous attacks had landed, but they had also missed, the wounds on Zylarith’s Soul existed, but they also never existed, victory was close, yet victory was impossible.
Life and death no longer stood against each other.
Creation and Destruction became the same thing.
Light revealed nothing.
Darkness hid everything by showing it clearly.
Balance tilted and remained balanced.
Time moved forward, backward, sideways, and nowhere.
Space had distance and no distance.
And Chaos...
It thrived.
Every truth contradicted itself.
And every single one of these contradictions was real.
"What the..."
Nux stood there like a fool who had no clue what was happening, his Law of Anomaly thrived where things made no sense, that was correct but...
This was worse!
Nux clenched his fists, trying to think of something but—
CRACK
His right arm broke, then it healed, then stayed broken, then it returned to normal.
And the pain?
The pain from all these versions struck at once.
He gritted his teeth in pain.
He tried to move, to get away from whatever this place had become, but there was nowhere to move, every direction led to the same place, and thatsame placewas not there.
Space was ruined entirely.
Other Primordial Energies were no different, every single one of them was ruined beyond what even Nux could understand, only Chaos thrived—
And no matter how strong Nux was, it was simply not possible for him to overpower Zylarith when it came to Chaos.
"Khrrrkkk!!"
Nux coughed out blood, his body that he had barely healed cracked again, that same torturous cycle he had been through repeated, only this time, it was far more agonizing.
"Gaaarhhhh!!"
Nux groaned in unbearable pain, his skin came off his body, revealing his bloodied state that he couldn’t recover from.
And it wasn’t just him, his entire Dimension, his entire Universe was being attacked and corrupted at the same time.
This was Zylarith’s last-ditch effort to come out on top.
And as the Infinity of Chaos saw his attack work, as he saw his child shivering in pain while his Universe was being forcibly taken away from him—
He grinned.
"Do you see it now?"
He spoke, his voice coming from every single direction.
"This was Chaos... before there was order to oppose it.
This is whyIwas the strongest.
This is why they feared me, even today."

Zylarith’s eyes burned brighter, Nux tried to move, but in this space he did not understand, even a simple action like that made his body scream in agony as it was crushed by a pressure he couldn’t comprehend.
"Kharrrkkkk!!"
He coughed blood again.
Zylarith raised one hand, he could practically see Nux’s current image being superimposed by the previous Infinity of Eternity right before he killed her, just like he was going to kill him.
"Now disappear."
He declared and—
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
All the Chaos collapsed towards Nux, every truth... turned against him.
He was strong, so his body broke down.
He resisted, so his body surrendered.
His Laws protected him, so they now wounded him.
He was alive, so he was now... dead.
He existed, so now he...
He was erased.
Yes, for one moment, Nux nearly vanished, his golden eyes dimmed, his universe began to crack, preparing for its end but then—
He smiled.
"A World where even the Truth itself is a Contradiction."
He commented with a blood-covered face as the shine in his eyes returned.
"Good."
He praised, the broken reality trembled, almost as if it was screaming for his help.
Nux moved his fingers, his body was still in a state of contradiction, dead, alive, whole, broken, present, erased, all at the same time, his Universe was still cracking, his Laws had all failed—
But this time, he did not fight it.
He simply observed the world around him and...
He began to understand it.
"What...?"
Zylarith couldn’t believe what he was seeing.
The First Contradiction was not an attack with ridiculous attack damage, it was more of a... battlefield control move.
A move that dismissed every single Primordial Energy, except Chaos, it basically made the Battlefield unlivable, even for the Infinities, even for Zylarith himself.
The only reason he was even alive and well was because of the dense Chaos Energy protecting him from the damage.
But Nux...
He did not have the Chaos Energy protecting him, even if he could use Chaos, all the Chaos around him now belonged to Zylarith and he had no control over it whatsoever.
He should have no way to protect himself.
Even the Infinity of Eternity didn’t.
Heck, even the other Three Infinities barely got out of this alive by using the Infinity of Eternity’s death as a cover to attack him from behind.
Then...
Why was he still alive!?
Why was the dense Chaos not crushing his body into something even his wives would not recognize?
Why?
What was happening?
Why, despite being surrounded by deadly energy, was his body... healing?
"W-What are you doing!?"
He asked, stuttering in shock and horror for the first time in his entire life.
He did not have any answers.
And the worst part?
There was nothing he could do.

While the Chaos Energydidprotect him, it was only because he had gathered a dense amount of it around him, it was like a cage he couldn’t get out of, or else the environment outside would tear him apart too.
He couldn’t use the Chaos Energy to attack him either, because he needed Chaos in its densest form to protect him, using even a little bit of it risked exposure—
Which, with half his Soul already gone—
He couldn’t risk.
So Zylarith could only watch.
"I ASKED WHAT IS IT YOU ARE DOING!?"
And scream.
But Nux did not answer—
He kept his eyes closed, his body broke, healed, died and lived, all at the same time, but the pace at which all of it was happening was... slowing down.
Almost as if...
Nux had begun to control it.
Which, again, should not have been possible but...
That was exactly what Nux was doing—
Doing what should have been impossible.
Because that was who he was—
An Anomaly.
And that was when it happened.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
Everything around Nux exploded, the dense Energy of Chaos scattered, the effect of the First Contradiction was still there but...
It wasn’t because of Zylarith.
It was because Nux decided to keep it there.

I will not forget that.

chapters.title: Chapter 2355: You are the one who follows that fixed system. I exist outside of it.
paragraphs: Zylarith waved his hand, prepared to end the First Contradiction but—
Nothing happened.
Zylarith stared at his surroundings with a dumbfounded look on his face and just then—
"It won’t work."
Nux shook his head.
"W-What do you mean!?"
Zylarith looked at him, wanting an explanation, an answer.
And this time, Nux decided to play along, just like Zylarith once did at the beginning of the battle.
Arrogant?
Not this time.

At this particular moment, Nux was absolutely sure of what he was doing because no matter how strong, skillful, or scheming Zylarith was, right now, he couldn’t move an inch, giving Nux all the time in the world he wanted to torment him, to play with him, to do... whatever he pleased with him.
"Do you still not understand it?"
Nux asked with an amused look on his face.
"I thought you were quicker than that."
Zylarith’s frown deepened even further, his mind was trying to think of an answer but no matter how desperately he tried—
Nothing came up.
Nux saw it and shook his head.
"Law of Anomaly."
He began.
"That is the Law I comprehended."
"The Law of... Anomaly...?"
Zylarith frowned in confusion, this was obviously the first time he was hearing an absurd name like this.
What did that even mean!?
It didn’t link to any of the Primordial Energies at all!
Zylarith’s thoughts were on his face, so much that Nux didn’t even need a second look to tell what he was thinking.
And that made him laugh.
"It is a Law that does not fit inside normal reality, logic, or universal rules. It allows me to create results that should not be possible, even if the method makes no sense.
It allows me to move when movement is impossible, damage someone even if my attack does not exist, or use Laws in ways they should not work.
And no—
It is not the same as your Chaos.
Whatever your Chaos is or however strong your mastery over it is, in the end, Chaos is still just a Law, one of the Primordial Energies.
It works by defining reality through Chaos. It twists, contradicts, or ruins order, structure, meaning, cause, and effect.
In other words, while Chaos does affect Laws, it too, has a structure, a pattern. It simply... turns a Law’s own logic against it.
I, however, am different.
I do not need to define anything.
I do not makeanother ruleto fight the already existing rules, I am an existence even reality itself fails to categorize.
While your Chaos stretches the limit of what is possible.
Icontrol the impossible."
Nux declared, his golden eyes shining brightly, almost as if he was declaring Zylarith’s end.
"And right now—
I made it so you ending your First Contradiction becomes impossible, it falls outside the limit you can stretch to.
So now, you no longer have power over it."
Nux smiled, his body already healing back to its natural state, only now, with his control over the Law of Anomaly being far stronger than what it was when the battle began—
His presence alone was different.
Nux Leander was different.
Now, the question was no longer whether he was comparable to the Infinities—
Because he was.
Now, the question was whether he could defeat all Four Infinities at the same time and honestly—
At some level, Nux knew he couldn’t.
Even as strong as he was right now, he wasn’t strong enough to face Four Infinities, all at the same time.
But that didn’t mean he couldn’t do it at all.
After all, strengthening his understanding of the Law of Anomaly wasn’t the final reward he was going to get out of this battle.
The final reward was Zylarith himself.
And his understanding of the Road to Infinity, the Power of Chaos, and using that Power of Chaos, an even deeper understanding of the Law of Anomaly.
Basically—
Once the battle ended, once Nux devoured Zylarith Chaosveil and absorbed him completely—
He would have made Zylarith’s powers... his own.
And the worst part?
He wouldn’t have Zylarith’s weakness.
Unlike Zylarith, he wouldn’t exist in a Soul Form, he would have a physical body stronger than the Infinities.
He would become a monster with no weaknesses.
A monster even the Four Infinities would have no way to defeat.
"LIES!! THAT ISN’T POSSIBLE!!"
That was when Zylarith screamed in desperation, his purple eyes burning intensely.
"I AM AN INFINITY!!
My understanding of my Law is stronger than yours! My Power over Chaos is more concentrated than yours! My Quality of Energy is better than yours!
Someone like you shouldn’t be able to overpower my Energy even if you are a part of another Universe!
That is impossible!"
He screamed, denying everything Nux just said.
And he was correct.
The Quality of Energy was still a factor Nux lacked. After all, even now, the quality of his energy was merely at the level of a Transcendent.

This was also the reason he never used direct Laws against Eternal Level opponents, he knew the Quality of their Energy was better than his, which would allow them to overpower him, this was the reason he relied on physical might instead.
And since he couldn’t defeat even an Eternal when it came to Quality of Energy, defeating an Infinity Level being like Zylarith should have been... impossible.
But...
That was when Nux smiled even more.
"Did you not hear what you just said yourself?"
He asked with a curious look on his face, Zylarith frowned and Nux quoted his words—
"Someone like me shouldn’t be able to overpower your Energy even if I am a part of another Universe!
That is...impossible!"
Nux put more focus on the word impossible and Zylarith—
He understood.
Nux’s grin widened.
"Didn’t I tell you?
You are the one who follows that fixed system.
I exist outside of it."
Zylarith’s eyes widened in absolute horror. Nux looked at him with a terrifying calm and then—
"You were a formidable opponent, Zylarith Chaosveil.
But now—
It is time you fall."
He declared Zylarith’s end like it was set in stone.
Zylarith’s body trembled, Nux on the other hand, took out a familiar weapon, a weapon he had trusted for hundreds of years now.
Its blade was long and impossibly straight, it was made out of a dark metal Nux still hadn’t found, within that metal, crimson veins pulsed strongly, synchronizing with Nux’s heartbeat.
It was the Bloodedge.
The Blade the Seer had gifted him all those years ago—
The Blade that—
Till now, had not disappointed him even once.
Zzzz
The moment the Blade appeared in his hand, it started devouring Nux’s energy, almost as if reacting to him and saying hello.
"I missed you too."
Nux chuckled as he looked at it.
Then, he looked at the trapped Zylarith.
Now, Zylarith was trapped, he knew that, if Nux wanted, he could continue to attack him again and again, all the way until Zylarith could no longer keep his existence together but—
That would take long.
So Nux thought of another method.
One simple strike.
A strike to end it all.

Nux knew that strike couldn’t be normal, it needed to be strong, absurdly strong if he wanted to cut down an Infinity’s Soul. Normal Weapons would not do it, he needed the Bloodedge because the Bloodedge was different.
Unlike other weapons, the Bloodedge had no limits, as long as Nux had enough Energy, the Bloodedge could form a strike that would cut down not one but all four Infinities at the same time.
And Energy was what Nux had... the most, he had... an unlimited amount of it.
With that thought in his mind, Nux chuckled, he looked at the Bloodedge that was still drinking his energy and then back at Zylarith, then—
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
He started injecting more and more energy into the Bloodedge.
BOOOOM
The Bloodedge’s Aura exploded, becoming stronger and stronger to the point where even Zylarith could sense it.
The attack that was forming was strong enough to cut him down, he needed to move, he needed to get away—
But his own First Contradiction made it impossible.
For the first time in his long life, Zylarith Chaosveil shivered.
"No!"
He almost begged.
But it didn’t matter—
Nux wasn’t planning on letting him go, he...couldn’tlet him go because of how important Zylarith was.
So he moved—
Once the Bloodedge had gathered enough Energy—
He sliced.
Or at least—
That was what he was about to do.
But just then—
The instant the Bloodedge had gathered enough energy, it did something out of expectation.
It...
Connected Zylarith’s Chaos that was in the environment with another, extremely familiar Chaos—
Chaos from the Main Universe.
And that—
Created a connection.
An opening.
A small, almost negligible opening, that any being in the Universe would have ignored—
That was if... they weren’t waiting for it.
But they were.
And the moment the connection was formed, the opening was made, Nux, who sensed it, widened his eyes in disbelief.
He tried to reverse it, he tried to use his power to undo what he had just done—
But it was already too late.
A black hand with sharp, non-uniform claws stopped the opening from closing and the next instant—
Through that opening, a terrifying presence forced its way inside Nux’s Dimension.
Ul’Thakar Darkness.
And he wasn’t alone.
Along with him, were the other Three Infinities.
Seraphielle Light.
Equarios Balance.
And Orravyn Eternity.
They were all here.
And Nux...
He looked at the sword in his hand as his eyes burned with unconcealed rage.
She...
She betrayed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2356: There will be no more battles we need to worry about.
paragraphs: He tried to stop it, he tried to close the opening, but before he could do it—
A black hand covered with what looked like living shadows, with long, sharp fingers and uneven claws, came from the other side and the moment it appeared, the entire dimension darkened.
Those claws grabbed the edge of the tiny opening, then, they tore it open with sheer might and—
BOOOOOM
A terrifying presence forced its way through.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
The void shook and a being stepped in.
Ul’Thakar Darkness.
And he wasn’t alone, just as his Darkness was taking over the void, a warm, gentle, pure light forced itself in as well and another figure with a blinding presence appeared right beside Ul’Thakar.
Seraphielle Light.
Nux’s face turned solemn, but at this point, he could already tell this wasn’t over and just as he expected, right after Seraphielle, he felt another presence.
This one was much calmer, much more... still.
Terrifyingly still.
The moment his presence was felt, the void that was shaking from the two foreign invaders stilled, as if... everything was now... perfectly Balanced, as all things should be.
It was Equarios Balance.
And after Equarios, came the last one. A being whose presence did not have any particular impact on the void itself, but to Nux, that felt more threatening than most—
Orravyn Eternity.
And once he was inside, the small opening that had formed finally closed down under Nux’s command, but at this point, it simply did not matter.
Nux stared at the four new beings that had forced their way inside his dimension.
Ul’Thakar Darkness.
Seraphielle Light.
Equarios Balance.
Orravyn Eternity.
Then, his eyes fell on the Infinity he had been fighting till now.
Zylarith Chaosveil.
Five Infinities.
Five absolute beings whose presence alone would make even a grown Universe shudder, and now, they were all here, standing right in front of him with those sickening smiles on their faces.
Nux’s golden eyes burned with unconcealed rage, he looked at the sword in his hand, the Sword that was still consuming his Energy and it didn’t take long for him to understand what had happened.
This wasn’t an accident.

There was no way toaccidentallymake a connection between the two Universes, even with Powers like Chaos and the Law of Anomaly, powers that could break reality in ways no being would understand, it wouldn’taccidentallycreate such a connection.
If it happened, if the connection was indeed formed—
Then it was... created.
Purposefully.
And as scheming and resourceful as Zylarith might be, he couldn’t do it.
It was someone else, someone who was here without actually being here.
Nux glanced at the sword in his hand, he recalled who gave it to him, he recalled every single interaction he had with her and—
The answer couldn’t be more obvious.
The Seer betrayed him.
And the betrayal wasn’t a sudden decision because something went wrong, she planned it from the very beginning, or at the very least—
The moment she gave him this Sword.
All Relics had at least one ability, Nux had been wondering what ability the Bloodedge possessed, all this while, he believed it wascuttingthrough anything as long as it was provided enough energy.
A perfect Relic that almost seemed tailor-made for him.
But today—
Nux realized the truth.
The Bloodedge didn’tseem likeit was tailor-made for him.
Itwastailor-made for him.
The Seer designed it just for him, but it wasn’t to help him, no, the Seer never had that intention.
The Seer came to him, helped him to initially gain his trust, gave him the sword so it quickly became the weapon he trusted the most so that at the very last moment—
When he required it the most—
The Sword would betray him.
That was the Bloodedge’s True Ability—
The Ability to connect to the Main Universe, from any place in the Multiverse.

Nux never found out about it because the energy it required was massive, but today, while he was up against an Infinity, when he needed to use most of his Energy, when he needed to charge his Sword to its fullest extent—
That was when the Bloodedge did what it was created for.
All according to how the Seer wanted.
"THAT BITCH!!!"
Amaya, who was watching everything through Nux’s eyes back in his own Universe, screamed in rage so fearsome that the very Universe trembled as it reacted to it.
"I KNEW I SHOULDN’T HAVE TRUSTED HER!!
I KNEW IT!!"
She screamed, her voice becoming more and more demonic. If it wasn’t for Vyriana and Astaria holding her down, she would have long left the place and appeared around Nux.
"UNHAND ME!"
She screamed, glaring at her sisters.
"I WILL KILL HER! I WILL KILL THAT BITCH IN THE MOST PAINFUL WAY POSSIBLE! I WILL MAKE HER REGRET BEING BORN!!!"
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE

Her scream echoed all over the Universe, the beings who heard her screams felt a fear so terrifying that their legs began to shake even when all that rage, hostility and hatred wasn’t even directed at them.
"I SAID UNHAND ME!!"
BOOOOOOOOM
Amaya screamed again as Devouring Mist exploded from her body in every direction, preparing to devour even her sisters if they didn’t unhand her soon enough.
But—
"Don’t be foolish."
Vyriana spoke in a cold, frosty voice.
"You aren’t the only one who is angry."
"Every single one of us is, but there is a reason we aren’t doing anything."
Astaria nodded.
The rest of the women clenched their fists, their heads lowered in shame and helplessness.
The moment his battle with Zylarith had begun, Nux had sealed the Space in his Universe, making it impossible for any being to use the power of Space.
Meaning that let alone leave the Universe, the people inside couldn’t even teleport 10 meters away, even Shadow was no exception to this rule.
So...
"All you are doing in the state you are right now, is hurting your sisters."
Riona commented with a cold, strict look on her face.
"Don’t do something you would regret once Nux returns."
She spoke and the moment Amaya’s mind registered the words ’Nux returns’, she finally calmed down.
And for the next few moments...
Absolute silence fell over the place.
The women looked at the nightmarish sight of all Five Infinities standing in front of them, in front of Nux and they—
They did not know what they were supposed to think.

They had watched the battle between Nux and Zylarith, they had watched what Nux had been through, they had seen him shiver in pain and that sight alone squeezed their hearts, Evane and Skyla had directly started crying, Amaya wanted to go and help but—

During that fight itself, the women knew, they realized how powerless they were. All they could do was keep the trust they had in Nux strong, even when his body was a mess, his Laws didn’t work and everything was against him.
But—
Could they do it again...?
Yes, the last time, Nux indeed came out victorious, he beat all odds and managed to defeat a being who was once known as the strongest Infinity but—
As impressive as it was—
It was a battle Nux chose himself.
But this...?
This wasn’t what Nux chose, this wasn’t going how Nux wanted it to.
So...
Could they really blindly put their trust in him in this situation?
The women did not know. Nux had gotten stronger after his battle with Zylarith, all of them, especially Shadow, who could feel the changes in the Universe most closely, knew it well.
But even Shadow didn’t know whether Nux’s newfound strength was enough to help him get out of... this.
And the other women were no different.
They all had the same, helpless looks on their faces.
All except one.
"Stop this nonsense."
The first wife spoke up, her eyes shining with a strong light.
"This is not Nux’s battle alone, it is ours too.
Think of it as a test of the trust we have in him."
She declared, then, she looked at every single one of her sisters and—
"And I do not know about you—
But this isn’t a test I would fail.
Nux will return.
And he will return victorious."
She raised her voice, her Aura strengthening so quickly that for a moment, every woman around her felt overwhelmed.
"This is it, women.
This is the final battle we have to participate in.

This is the battle after which, Nux will prove to be the strongest there is, the battle after which we will have every little thing we ever wanted, a battle after which our children will never need to worry about resources again—
So rejoice."
Felberta paused.
"Because after this—
There will be no more battles we need to worry about."
She spoke and just as her words lit up a ray of hope in the women’s eyes—
Something happened.
Nux removed his domain and appeared in the Main Universe, a Universe where his physical strength, the only true advantage he held over the Infinities, would be restricted.

chapters.title: Chapter 2357: You are quite arrogant, just like I predicted.
paragraphs: "Because after this—
There will be no more battles we need to worry about."
Felberta spoke, her words igniting a ray of hope in the women’s eyes, but just then—
Nux removed his domain, essentially erasing the dimension he created and... appeared in the Main Universe together with the Five Infinities.
"What...?"
And the moment the women realized what had just happened, they blinked in shock, even Felberta, who had shown blind trust in Nux till now, was shaken.
After all, no woman here understood what Nux had just done.

Half the reason Nux won against Zylarith was because when he was inside his Universe’s influence, he was at his strongest, his body was so unbearably strong that attacks that would crush even Infinities only wounded him.

But that advantage disappeared the moment he left his Universe, the Main Universe’s restriction would weaken his body significantly, so much that the body which was far stronger than an Infinity’s body, would now actually be much, much weaker than it.
Let alone an attack like the First Contradiction, even a normal attack, if connected well—
Would end the battle right there and then.
Then—
Why would Nux do it?
Was it because he didn’t want Zylarith to participate in the battle? Was Zylarith truly that big of a threat when it was no longer a one-on-one battle?
That was the only reasoning the women could think of, or at least—
Most of them could.
But Shadow was different.
She knew the truth.

In the battle against Zylarith, Zylarith had managed to seep his Chaos Energy inside their Universe and while his influence still hadn’t grown to the point where others could sense him, the fact was that he still managed to influence it.

Meaning that if Zylarith was given enough time, he could have taken control over their Universe, or at the very least, made his way into their Universe, giving him the ability to attack not just them, but even their children.
And that was what Nux was trying to protect.

Because if the Four Infinities stopped him while Zylarith succeeded in entering their Universe, everything Nux was fighting for would be over. The extra strength he had in his own Universe would not do him any good.
So the only thing Nux could do here—
Was to leave his Universe and fight them at a disadvantage.
At the very least, he won’t be a problem anymore.
Shadow muttered as her eyes fell on Zylarith, who, the moment he entered the Main Universe, stopped controlling all the Chaos around him and moved like he didn’t even exist.
Back in the Main Universe, Nux stood in front of the Five Infinities in a vast empty space. It looked identical to his own dimension back in his Universe, but Nux could feel the difference clearly.
Far away, stars burned, galaxies glowed, there were no worlds nearby, but Nux could still feel their distant presence.
And along with it—
He could feel the restriction.
That unknown force which usually dropped his strength by more than ninety percent. But this time, Nux wasn’t the same being he was anymore—
He was a being who controlled Impossibility.
An exception to every rule there was.
The Universe restricted any foreign being’s strength, that was the rule, was it not?
Nux decided to become its sole exception.
And it worked.
His strength returned.
Not all of it of course, his understanding of the Law of Anomaly may have strengthened, but completely resisting the restriction of a fully grown Universe was something even he could not do.
But even then—
Nux had retained almost seventy percent of his strength and right now, that was all he could do.
He looked at his enemies, then he looked at the sword in his hand and he tried to crush it, to get rid of it, to break it into countless pieces but—
As if it expected that—
Whoosh
The Sword suddenly turned into blood-red mist, and it disappeared out of existence, or at least, that was what everyone present believed.
But Nux...
He frowned since he could still feel the connection he had formed with it.
A connection he wanted to get rid of right here and now but—
"Any other being’s mind would be too occupied with fear to even try and understand what just happened,
But you understood everything in an instant.
For that, I applaud you, Anomaly."
Nux heard a voice.
It was Orravyn Eternity.
The Infinity of Eternity looked at him with an amused, almost impressed look on his face.
"You overestimate yourself if you believe your lot’s presence is enough to overwhelm someone with fear."
Nux snorted, acting dismissive.
Of course, inwardly, his mind was moving at an impossible speed.

Too many things had happened in too short of a time. Just three seconds ago, he was preparing his final attack to defeat Zylarith, but from that to this particular instant, the Bloodedge showed its true purpose, the Seer betrayed him, the four Infinities forcefully invaded his Universe, he removed his domain to protect his wives, and now—
Now he was standing in front of these monsters, alone.
And his mind had already figured out a way to crawl his way out of this situation.
The situation was clear.
He couldn’t win.
He couldn’t possibly win against all Four Infinities even if his understanding of the Law of Anomaly had strengthened considerably, especially when he wasn’t even inside his own Universe.
However, that was only true if he remained as strong as he currently was.
But—
Nux right now, wasn’t the same as Nux before.
Now, he had something, a way to grow.

He had... half of Zylarith Chaosveil’s Soul, Soul that he had erased in his own Dimension, Soul that his Universe had secretly collected, hoping to complete it inside his Main Universe, under his control.
Now of course, his current Soul was merely a fragment of his true self, but that didn’t mean it wasn’t valuable, it was still Zylarith’s Soul, something that had his memories.
Very jumbled, almost incomprehensible memories, but if given enough time, Nux could use those memories to strengthen his understanding of Chaos and by linking it further, Anomaly.
That was all Nux needed.
Time.
And that was what he was trying to buy.
"You are quite arrogant, just like I predicted."
Orravyn’s eyes shined as he scanned Nux with interest.
"Arrogant? Have you ever been humble in front of creatures you deem beneath you?
Why do you expect me to do the same?"
Nux questioned and the instant he did, instead of getting offended, Orravyn’s smile widened.
It was the exact reaction Nux was looking for.
He hadn’t met any of these Infinities before, but with all the information he had, it wasn’t difficult to understand how twisted their personalities were.
The Infinities loved tormenting those who rose to challenge them.
As for those who looked down upon them, while there hadn’t been a being in the history of the Universe to ever do that—
It was clear that they would want to torment him even more, they would want to make an example out of him and that was exactly what he wanted.
He wanted to lure them into taking their time tormenting him, time that he would use to understand Zylarith’s Fragment’s messy memories and comprehend his Law of Absolute Chaos.
"Creatures you deem beneath you, huh...?
Your perspective of the world would be quite amusing indee—"
Orravyn tried to answer, but just then—
"That is enough."
Zylarith spoke up.
His purple eyes looked right at Orravyn’s face and with a serious look on his face—
"Stop dilly-dallying,
Kill him right now."
Orravyn frowned but before he could do anything, the Infinity of Darkness, Ul’Thakar, grinned out loud.
"Would you look at that~
The great Zylarith Chaosveil is being wary of a child.
Oh, how low the mighty have fallen~"
He chuckled, mocking Zylarith without a tinge of shame. But Zylarith didn’t lose his temper, instead, he glanced at Ul’Thakar and spoke with a solemn tone.
"The boy is not weak, Ul’Thakar.
He is a threat.
A graver threat than you realize.
I made the same mistake of underestimating him, and I paid the price with half of my Soul. If it weren’t for her sword, I would have perished."
The one who reacted the most at those words wasn’t the Infinities they were directed to, it was Nux.
HerSword.
He was right.
It was indeed the Seer who had betrayed him.
For now, that didn’t matter, because while the Infinities were having a discussion, all his focus was on Zylarith’s Soul he had devoured.
An hour.
That was all Nux needed.
Well, more accurately, he needed an hour of not fighting, so he could divert all his attention to Zylarith’s fragmented, chaotic and messy memories and make sense out of them.
But if the fight started and his attention shifted—
He would need even more time.
That, however, didn’t seem to be the problem right now because—
"Oh~ The boy’s scary because he defeated me~
As if that’s supposed to make us serious."
The Infinities didn’t seem the least bit bothered by him.
