chapters.title: Chapter 2390: I am back~ Did you miss me?
paragraphs: The room was deathly silent.
But this time, it wasn’t the silence that came with grief, it was silence filled with hope.

Every woman present stared at the thread of shadow stretched upward. Shadow continued to sense more and more worlds being devoured at a rate so quick that for a moment, it felt like this was the end of the Universe.
The resources they had saved for the children were already emptied out at this point and... other worlds were being devoured.
But...
Not a single world that carried life was affected.
And that reassured Shadow.
If it were any being other than Nux, he would have devoured any world he wanted, life wouldn’t matter to him.

But Nux was only targeting lifeless worlds, worlds he had either saved up in the name of resources for his children and the Universe’s growth, and the worlds he had set aside as Stars—Worlds that he usually used just so he could use their Energy in battle, giving him a nearly endless supply of energy.
He was devouring them all.
He was devouring so much that for a moment, Shadow looked worried.
"He is using too much..."
She muttered in a low voice.
"How much?"
Vyriana narrowed her eyes.
"Nearly half is gone and he isn’t slowing down."
Shadow answered.
Hearing those words, Astaria tightened her grip around her sword, looking at the rising thread of shadow with a cautious look on her face.
As more worlds were devoured, what seemed like a mere thread began to change, it began taking a shape.
"Is that... a spine...?"
Thyra narrowed her eyes.
"Yes."
Rune nodded.
More and more shadow gathered.
Spine.
Ribs.
Shoulders.
A skull.
Abodywas forming.
A body that had a nearly identical frame as Nux’s.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
The Universe trembled again.
Then something else began to happen.
"What’s happening?"
Felberta questioned as she noticed the look in Shadow’s eyes.
"A few worlds are being emptied out."
"Emptied out?"
"The people there are being sent to other worlds."
"And those empty worlds..."
Felberta narrowed her eyes and Shadow nodded.
"They are being devoured."
"Empty out more worlds.
Put them all in Umbrasol if we have to."
That was when Amaya instructed.
Shadow turned towards her, a little taken aback.
Really?
That would break their Universe’s entire structure.
Umbrasol’s peace would disappear. Of course, that peace didn’t matter right now, not to them.
But the real issue was that...
They... didn’t even know if it was actually Nux...

Should they... really hand their Universe over to someone on a silver platter just because theythoughtit was Nux...?

"I said do it."
She spoke, in a stricter tone as she looked right into Shadow’s eyes.
"You saw what happened here.
Every single one of us lost control.
That alone should be more than enough to prove that none of us are capable of surviving without him anyway.
So take the risk.
And..."
Amaya then turned back towards the body that was being formed and—
"I may not be able to sense it, but I canfeelit.
It is Nux."
She spoke, her dark eyes shining with an intense light.
Hearing those words, Shadow too, looked at the half-finished body, then, a determined look appeared on her face and—
She waved her hand, the Energy of Space moved and every living being in the Universe, no matter what they were doing right now, was moved to Umbrasol and the largest three other Worlds they had.
All Four Worlds were overcrowded beyond belief. The people looked at people who had appeared out of nowhere with surprised, confused looks on their faces, their reactions even worse.
Some started fighting, armies began slaughtering people who didn’t even understand what was happening—
But for now—
Shadow didn’t care.
She only looked at the half-finished body in front of her.
Her actions seemed like they had lifted the only restriction it was facing, the speed at which the worlds were being devoured increased tenfold.
Sixty percent of the worlds were devoured.
Then seventy.
Then eighty...
And the body in front of them began to change again.
Bones formed first.
Then the muscles.
The shoulders.
The chest.
The arms.
The hands.
And...
The women’s expressions changed.
They could see it.
They were... sure of it.
Those were Nux’s hands.
Nux’s hands.
"That’s... Nux..."
Aisha let out a broken sound as she tried to step forward, but Melia held her back.
"Wait."
She spoke softly.
Tears streamed down Aisha’s face.
"That’s Nux..."
She raised her voice.
"I know."
Melia nodded, but she didn’t let Aisha go.
No one was supposed to interrupt it, they couldn’t take any chances.
More and more worlds were devoured.
And Shadow understood what exactly was happening here.
It wasn’t a simple Nux reforming his body like he usually does. Every time he did that in the past, his connection to the Universe existed, hisSoulexisted, even hisbodyexisted.
Yes, even when Nux waskilled, what died was never his true body.
It was merely... a projection of his true body.
His true body had always been... his very Universe.
So every time hedied, all he needed to do was return to the Universe and create another projection.
As for the resources required to create another projection, those were taken from the previous projection that was destroyed.
It was a process that never consumed an ounce of Energy.
But now?
Now hisSoulwas erased, he was no longer connected to his Universe and hisTrue Bodywas no longer... his.
So right now—
He didn’t just have to reform a mere projection.
He needed to reform his Soul.
He needed to reform his connection with the Universe.
And he needed a new Body.
This came with a price.

A price that he was paying by using almost every world he had devoured all this while, the price of returning his Universe to an empty, new state, pushing its progress back by a good few million years.
But it didn’t matter.
To Shadow, or any other woman, it didn’t matter.

Because as they saw the body forming in front of them, as they saw the skin beginning to reappear, starting from the chest, spreading across the arms, the legs, the neck, all the way up to... the face.
Hisface.
The face none of them would ever mistake, no matter how perfectly it wascopied.
It was Nux.
The women were now sure of it before the face was even formed.
And finally—
After every single world other than the Four that carried life was devoured, when the Universe was completely emptied out—
Nux’s eyelids trembled and slowly, very, very slowly, they opened—

Those golden eyes looked up with the same distant look that worried the Seer, it was almost as if the women standing in front of him were no different than the countless Universes he had observed in the countless years he had spent inside the Multiverse.
Felberta.
Skyla.
Lane.
Shadow.
Edda.
Allura.
Thyra.
Amaya.
Ember.
Evane.
Astaria.
Aisha.
Melia.
Riona.
Vyriana.
Rune.
Aeliana.
Lyriana.
Eisheth.
Sharnoth.

He observed them all with the same look on his face, he noticed their expressions, the dried tears in their eyes, their excitement as they saw him, their earnest patience, waiting for him to say something—
Anything.
And the next instant—
The distant look in Nux’s eyes faded into oblivion and was replaced with the same, usual snarky light—
"I am back~"
He grinned.
"Did you miss me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2391: I paid the price.
paragraphs: "I am back~"
Nux grinned, the distant look in his eyes that had worried the Seer for millions of years, disappearing as if it was never there in the first place.
"Did you miss me?"
He asked.
And the next instant—
"YOU BASTARD!!!"
Vyriana launched herself towards him and—
BOOOOOM
She punched, her fist fitting right into his stomach.
"Khawwwrrkk!!"
Nux coughed out a black liquid which later turned red. His body began to tremble.
"Oi... what kind of welcome back is that...?"
He groaned, barely speaking the words.
Vyriana, who was already holding him, just snorted.
"Be glad I didn’t kill you."
The Dragon then began wiping the blood on his face, her eyes burned with strong intensity until all that intensity finally came out in the form of tears.
Nux laughed at that—
"You are the one who punched me, why are you crying?"

He spoke as he gently wiped her tears with a trembling hand, but that didn’t help, in fact, the moment he began wiping her tears, more tears came out, as if she could no longer hold herself together and broke down the moment he was here.
"Don’t push it..."
Vyriana spoke in a hoarse voice, unable to control her tears at all.
The rest of the women were no different, they quickly surrounded Nux, each touching parts of his body, almost as if making sure it was actually him.
In an instant—
Nux, who had been inside that nightmarish Multiverse for who knows how long, was now buried under his wives.
A place so heavenly that even though he was being suffocated, the comfort he felt was so strong that he almost wanted to let himself go.
"Ah~ Now this is what’s worth dying for~"
Nux let out a long sigh in relief, letting his body be touched by these ridiculously beautiful women.
"You really have let go of your fear of death after dying, haven’t you?"
Ember spoke, her moist golden-red eyes shining dangerously as she glared at Nux.
The women were more than a little sensitive to the word ’dying’ right now, Nux understood it, so he shut his mouth like a good boy.
Ember nodded, satisfied.
For the next few hours, the group stayed like this. Nux had already moved the children into a different room with a wave of his hand, he and the women had now shifted onto the bed.
They didn’t do anything.

Nux didn’t have the strength to do anything, he could barely move. The women sensed it as well, and honestly, right now, as much as they wanted to do thosethingswith him, what they wanted even more was to...feelhim.
To... let it sink in that their husband was not dead.
To feel the ease and the comfort that thought brought to them.
So all they did was touch him gently and... feel his presence without saying even a word. Even the most talkative ones like Skyla and Sharnoth were silent, overwhelmed by strong emotions.
It was strange.

To think all their built-up frustration, everything they had been through ever since it began, every extreme emotion that they felt, every time they thought about killing themselves, and the strong, overwhelming feeling of relief they felt after they realized he was back—
To think all those loud, strong emotions were expressed through... silence.
It was... so strange to think about...
But it happened.
For 10 whole hours, no one spoke, Nux drowned himself in the feeling of being near his wives, trying to heal himself from the countless years he had spent in the Multiverse.
The wives were silent too, until—
"You really did come back..."
Evane muttered with a gentle, weak look on her face as she stared at Nux and looked into his eyes.
That made Nux smile.
"Did you think I’d leave you?"
"You sure did."
Ember commented, holding Nux’s neck like she wanted to strangle him to death.
"We saw that recording."
Nux lowered his eyes as he remembered that.
Ember didn’t push forward either, it wasn’t something she wanted to talk about.
"So? What happened? Why are you so weak now?"

Vyriana asked the question. She did it to change the topic but also because she was curious. When she hit him, she didn’t mean to injure him, but Nux was injured and his healing was slowed significantly.
Nux looked at her and—
"I paid the price."
He answered as he looked at Shadow.
He knew she knew.
Shadow stared at him and nodded with a meaningful look on her face.
"Price?"
Astaria frowned, wanting to know more and Nux just laughed.
"I returned from nothingness.
Do you truly think there wouldn’t be a price?"
"As if you move according to what we think."
Riona rolled her eyes.
Nux smiled at those words.
Then—
"How did you come back alive?"
Edda questioned.
While she was glad it happened, Edda was no fool, she knew what happened, she knew even if itwasNux, this wasn’t something he could just... return from.
Unless...
"Someone helped me."
Nux answered honestly.
"Someone helped you...?"
The women raised their eyebrows.
Who could possibly help Nux from the situation he was in?
That should have been... impossible.
"Who was it?"
Aeliana questioned.
Whoever it was, she would kowtow to him if that was what was needed to express her deepest, heartiest gratitude.
Nux looked at her, then at the others.
He could see they all wanted to meet her, hissaviour.
So he looked in a particular direction and—
"Come out now.
Stop hiding.
I know the last thing you are is shy."
He called out.

The women frowned, they all turned in the direction Nux was looking at. For a moment, there was nothing, even Shadow didn’t sense anything or anyone, which was surprising since she should know every being there was inside their Universe.
But then—
A figure began to form.
A figure every single one of them was familiar with.
"I am notshy, Nux Leander.
I am scared."
The Seer answered, looking at the women’s, especially Amaya’s distorted face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2392: You are brave. I give you that.
paragraphs: "I am notshy, Nux Leander.
I am scared."
The Seer answered, looking at the women’s, especially Amaya’s, distorted face and how could she not be?
Amaya was looking at her like she was seeing her worst enemy, an enemy who had taken everything from her, an enemy she swore to destroy, to tear, piece by piece, no matter how long it took.
The Devourer spoke, in a hoarse, dangerous voice.
"You dare come here..."
She spoke, but just as her energy was about to explode and surround the Seer.
"Amaya Leander."
The Seer spoke up.
"I cannot enter this Universe any time I desire. Your Universe is different than others—"
She then looked at Shadow and—
"You should know that more than I do, no?"
Shadow didn’t say anything.
Her silence, however, was all the answer one needed. The Seer looked back at Amaya, who was still glaring at her, then she pointed at Nux.
"He brought me here."
Amaya looked at Nux.
And Nux... when he tried to say something—
"Don’t look at him."
The Seer spoke again, regaining Amaya’s attention.
"That was our deal.
I give him three Gifts in return for a favour.
Now, I am calling in that favour."
"Heh... Gifts..."
Vyriana snorted at those words.
"You dare call thoseGifts...?
First, you make Lord Azriel a Universe’s Child, forcing him to start from the beginning, essentially removing our strongest ally.
Your second gift was that Sword that helped the Four Infinities invade our Universe, forcing Nux to face Five Infinities alone.
And your third gift was Zylarith’s whereabouts, directly pushing Nux to go challenge him in a battle.
Not a single one of these wereGifts—
They were tools.
Tools you prepared to ultimately complete your own vicious plans."
The Dragon snorted, not buying her bullshit for another second.
The rest of the women were no different, their anger and distrust were glaringly obvious, the Seer, however, remained calm even in front of those intense gazes.
"I helped Lord Azriel become a Universe’s Child to protect Yrniel from danger, with the Universe’s Shields, the Infinities could never target Yrniel."
She answered.
"Do not forget, there was a time when you and Nux went head to head against Zylarith because he attacked your mercenary party.
If he had done that with Yrniel present, Zylarith would have moved the Infinities’ attention to Yrniel and Azriel, ending them both at the same time."
The Seer then looked at Nux.
"You have seen his memories, have you not? You should know that."
The wives turned towards Nux and he...
"It was one of his plans."
Nux nodded.
As someone who had read his memories, he knew everything Zylarith knew and planned to do.
The Seer looked back at Vyriana, then at Aeliana—
"As strong as he was, his connection to Yrniel weakened him, it was his weakness.
If I hadn’t done what I did, your Father would have lost his life."
Then, she glanced at Felberta—
"So would have your son."
At Aisha—
"You, your sisters."
At Melia and Rune—
"Your family."
At Eisheth and Lyriana—
"Your daughters."
She looked at every person present and—
"With Yrniel gone, every single one of you would have lost many people you cherished, even some of you would have died as well."
Then, the Seer looked at Vyriana and—
"So no, my actions did not weaken your strongest ally, my actions protected him and the world you cherish the most in all of the Universe."
She clarified herself.

Vyriana turned silent, not knowing what she was supposed to say. Many other women were silent too, when they thought about the people they had left in Yrniel, they didn’t feel like they were in a position to say something.
Amaya, however, was different. She looked at the woman in front of her and questioned directly.
"Then what about your Sword?
Why did it open a portal and lead the Infinities inside our Universe? Or are you going to deny that as well?"
"I did what I had to do."
The Seer answered but Amaya wasn’t having it.
"Oh? You did what you had to do, is it?
Youhadto lead Nux to Zylarith, youhadto lead the other Four Infinities to invade his Universe, youhadto force him into a battle against the Five Infinities—
Then, even against all odds, when he was winning—
Youhadto appear and make sure Nux was erased.
Is that what you are trying to say?"
She questioned in a sarcastic, enraged tone, and the Seer—
"Yes."
She nodded.
"That is what I am trying to say."
BOOOOOOM
And the instant she said those words, Amaya’s face turned frosty as her Aura burst out.
"You are brave.
I give you that."
She spoke in a heavy, demonic voice.
But the Seer—
"I have said this before, I will say it again, Amaya Leander.
You understand the existence named Nux Leander the most out of every single being present in this room.
Do you agree with this statement?"
She asked a simple question.
Amaya narrowed her eyes at those words.
Was this... an attempt to drive a wedge between the women here?

If that was truly the case, it was quite pathetic. After all, she knew that they may fight like cats and mice when they were alone, in front of a common enemy, they would never turn against each other.
And Amaya was right.
No woman reacted to the Seer’s words.
The Seer, however, did not care.
She just looked at Amaya, waiting for an answer.
"You didn’t answer my question."
She reminded gently.
"What does that have to do with any of it?"
Amaya questioned back.
"Please, I would like an answer."
The Seer requested politely, Amaya narrowed her eyes and the Seer—
"The man you trust the most in your entire life brought me here, that should at least make me a little endurable, no?
Please, humour me."
She requested again and this time—
Amaya agreed.
"I know him well."
She nodded as she momentarily looked at Nux, then back at her.
"What do you think would have happened if Nux saw his children dying and the reason they were dying was because he was too weak to protect them?"
The Seer questioned.

sentences.text: "I am notshy, Nux Leander.
I am scared."
The Seer answered, looking at the women’s, especially Amaya’s, distorted face and how could she not be?
Amaya was looking at her like she was seeing her worst enemy, an enemy who had taken everything from her, an enemy she swore to destroy, to tear, piece by piece, no matter how long it took.
The Devourer spoke, in a hoarse, dangerous voice.
"You dare come here..."
She spoke, but just as her energy was about to explode and surround the Seer.
"Amaya Leander."
The Seer spoke up.
"I cannot enter this Universe any time I desire.
Your Universe is different than others—"
She then looked at Shadow and—
"You should know that more than I do, no?"
Shadow didn’t say anything.
Her silence, however, was all the answer one needed.
The Seer looked back at Amaya, who was still glaring at her, then she pointed at Nux.
"He brought me here."
Amaya looked at Nux.
And Nux... when he tried to say something—
"Don’t look at him."
The Seer spoke again, regaining Amaya’s attention.
"That was our deal.
I give him three Gifts in return for a favour.
Now, I am calling in that favour."
"Heh...
Gifts..."
Vyriana snorted at those words.
"You dare call thoseGifts...?
First, you make Lord Azriel a Universe’s Child, forcing him to start from the beginning, essentially removing our strongest ally.
Your second gift was that Sword that helped the Four Infinities invade our Universe, forcing Nux to face Five Infinities alone.
And your third gift was Zylarith’s whereabouts, directly pushing Nux to go challenge him in a battle.
Not a single one of these wereGifts—
They were tools.
Tools you prepared to ultimately complete your own vicious plans."
The Dragon snorted, not buying her bullshit for another second.
The rest of the women were no different, their anger and distrust were glaringly obvious, the Seer, however, remained calm even in front of those intense gazes.
"I helped Lord Azriel become a Universe’s Child to protect Yrniel from danger, with the Universe’s Shields, the Infinities could never target Yrniel."
She answered.
"Do not forget, there was a time when you and Nux went head to head against Zylarith because he attacked your mercenary party.
If he had done that with Yrniel present, Zylarith would have moved the Infinities’ attention to Yrniel and Azriel, ending them both at the same time."
The Seer then looked at Nux.
"You have seen his memories, have you not?
You should know that."
The wives turned towards Nux and he...
"It was one of his plans."
Nux nodded.
As someone who had read his memories, he knew everything Zylarith knew and planned to do.
The Seer looked back at Vyriana, then at Aeliana—
"As strong as he was, his connection to Yrniel weakened him, it was his weakness.
If I hadn’t done what I did, your Father would have lost his life."
Then, she glanced at Felberta—
"So would have your son."
At Aisha—
"You, your sisters."
At Melia and Rune—
"Your family."
At Eisheth and Lyriana—
"Your daughters."
She looked at every person present and—
"With Yrniel gone, every single one of you would have lost many people you cherished, even some of you would have died as well."
Then, the Seer looked at Vyriana and—
"So no, my actions did not weaken your strongest ally, my actions protected him and the world you cherish the most in all of the Universe."
She clarified herself.
Vyriana turned silent, not knowing what she was supposed to say.
Many other women were silent too, when they thought about the people they had left in Yrniel, they didn’t feel like they were in a position to say something.
Amaya, however, was different.
She looked at the woman in front of her and questioned directly.
"Then what about your Sword?
Why did it open a portal and lead the Infinities inside our Universe?
Or are you going to deny that as well?"
"I did what I had to do."
The Seer answered but Amaya wasn’t having it.
"Oh?
You did what you had to do, is it?
Youhadto lead Nux to Zylarith, youhadto lead the other Four Infinities to invade his Universe, youhadto force him into a battle against the Five Infinities—
Then, even against all odds, when he was winning—
Youhadto appear and make sure Nux was erased.
Is that what you are trying to say?"
She questioned in a sarcastic, enraged tone, and the Seer—
"Yes."
She nodded.
"That is what I am trying to say."
BOOOOOOM

"You are brave.
I give you that."
She spoke in a heavy, demonic voice.
But the Seer—
"I have said this before, I will say it again, Amaya Leander.
You understand the existence named Nux Leander the most out of every single being present in this room.
Do you agree with this statement?"
She asked a simple question.
Amaya narrowed her eyes at those words.
Was this... an attempt to drive a wedge between the women here?
If that was truly the case, it was quite pathetic.
After all, she knew that they may fight like cats and mice when they were alone, in front of a common enemy, they would never turn against each other.
And Amaya was right.
No woman reacted to the Seer’s words.
The Seer, however, did not care.
She just looked at Amaya, waiting for an answer.
"You didn’t answer my question."
She reminded gently.
"What does that have to do with any of it?"

"I know him well."

The Seer questioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2393: I am going to tear them apart.
paragraphs: "What do you think would have happened if Nux saw his children dying and the reason they were dying was because he was too weak to protect them?"
The Seer questioned and the instant she did—
Amaya and all the other women turned silent.
It wasn’t that they didn’t know the answer. They... knew it too well.
Nux loved his children, every single one of them.
If he saw them die right in front of his eyes, no matter the reason, he would... lose himself.
He would think of killing himself, but then he would think of them, he would want to live for their sakes but seeing his state, they wouldn’t want to live either but would live for his sake.
This would either push them into a state where they all lived for each other’s sake, or...
They all ended their lives.
Those were the only two possibilities here.
A life worse than death or... death.
But—
Amaya didn’t say that, after all, she could tell what she was playing at.
"Our children wouldn’t die."
The Seer shook her head at those words.
"It wasn’t me who told the Infinities about Vashti, Amaya. They figured it out on their own."
The Seer looked at Nux and he...
"Zylarith was the one behind it."
He did not lie.

Zylarith had been tracing his steps and investigating for a long while, learning about Vashti was only natural, after all, no matter how weak Zylarith was in his Soul Form, Zylarith was still far more resourceful than any being he had encountered before.
Nux and others couldn’t stop him, especially since they didn’t even know where she was.
With Nux’s confirmation, the Seer nodded and made her point.
"If I hadn’t appeared, you would still be stuck in the same situation where neither you nor your forces could leave your Universe and your children would have starved from the lack of resources."
"You do not know that."
Amaya countered.
"We would have found a way."
"If you did, Nux would have never attacked Zylarith in the first place."
"He attacked because he knew he could win."
Astaria countered but—
"Then why did he leave that final recording behind?"
The Seer questioned back.
"That recording wasn’t about his battle with the Five Infinities, you remember that as well.
That recording was about his battle with Zylarith.
When Nux went to face him, he didn’t know if hecouldwin. The possibility of dying did come to his mind, even then, he made the decision.
Someone like him would only do that if he had no other choice."
The Seer pointed out, then, she looked at Amaya who was gritting her teeth and—
"There was no other way, Amaya.
Facing Zylarith was the only way to ensure your children’s survival, Nux knew that, that was the entire reason he risked his life in the first place.
So yes—
If I hadn’t appeared.
If I hadn’t given Zylarith’s whereabouts.
Your childrenwould havedied.
And you and the man you cherish would have broken down into bits even you wouldn’t have been able to recognise."
She countered, not raising her voice for a single moment the entire time.
"As if your existence changed that."
That was when Shadow snorted.
The Seer looked at her and the Goddess of the Universe continued—
"Our children’s lives are still at risk, now more so than before because now, we don’t have any resources needed to help them cultivateat all.
Not to mention Nux has now lost most of his strength.
So if before, Nux could fight Infinities andmight havewon.
Now, victory is impossible."
Shadow then glared at the Seer with raw and intense anger and—
"For someone who made an already difficult situation significantly more difficult—
You talk an awful lot."

She spoke, locking up the Universe, making sure there was no way the Seer could leave. That action made the Seer react a little. All this while, she had only been using a projection of herself, so her ’life’ was never exactly in danger.
But right now—
Nux had brought her ’real self’ to his Universe, if something happened to her here then—
Shewouldcease to exist.
However—
"I do not claim I made the situation easier."
She shook her head, still as calm as before.
"What I am trying to say is that I am not the enemy you make me out to be.
I had a deal with Nux.
I give him three things he would find extremely useful and in return, he gives me what I want.
And what I wanted... was only possible if Nux lost his life the way he did."
Shadow clenched her fists at those words, the Seer, however, did not stop.
"And mind you, I waited.

I always knew I needed Nux to perish before I could get what I wanted, and at any point in time, I could always reveal his whereabouts to the Infinities and have him die in a way he or any of you here wouldn’t even have known it was me who manipulated the entire thing.
Then, I could have easily helped him return to life like I did now and have him and every single one of you be eternally grateful to me.
But I did not do it.
I waited until there was no choice, I waited until Nux himself would have died anyway to finally make my move.
I do not claim to be a selfless, giving being—
But I am not a dishonest manipulator.
I waited, then I explained every single thing I did and why I did it, every single lie I ever said and why I said it.
And now I stand before you—
Not as someone you should be grateful to, but as someone you judge."
The Seer spoke honestly.
"Also..."
Then, after a slight hesitation.
"Your children’s lives... may not be in danger.
It... shouldn’t be anymore."
"What...?"
Felberta’s face changed at those words.
The rest of the women were the same, every single one of them stared at the Seer and the Seer...
In the end, even after making her case for so long.
She had no choice but to look at Nux and the moment she did—
She saw him smiling at her, like he was expecting this to happen, and that made her mouth twitch in frustration.
This little...
It was his way of taking his revenge...
’I should have expected it.’
She cursed herself for putting herself in this situation, she knew what Nux was like, probably more than his wives did, she should have known he would do something like this.
She was just...
The image she had of Nux was overwritten by the time she spent with him, the time she saw him showing no reaction to anything, the time she saw his cold, distant eyes.
For a moment, that made her pause.
Remembering those eyes and comparing them with the light in his current eyes, it was almost as if she was implanted with false memories.
To think... one would change this much just because he was now with his wives...
She looked back at Nux’s wives and...
’They are fortunate.’
She thought inwardly as a strange feeling rose in her heart.
Right now, however, she had other concerns, so she looked at Nux, her mouth twitching again, but she begged—
"Help me out here, will you?"
"Whaaaatt? I didn’t quite catch that."
Nux asked with a playful grin.
"Help me!"
The Seer raised her voice.
"Hmmmmm? Is that how you ask for help???"
Nux tilted his head.
The Seer’s mouth twitched even further, but still, she took deep breaths to calm herself, then, she looked at him with a forced smile and—
"Nux Leander, I am in a difficult position, can you please help me?"
"Hmmm."
Nux let out a voice, then, after thinking about it for a while—
"We still need to work on that tone of yours, but for now, this will do."
He nodded.
And those words made his wives frown.
"She is right, because of her Third Gift—
Our children are not in danger, not anymore."
Nux grinned.
"Her... third gift?"
Felberta frowned.
"Zylarith’s coordinates?"
"Well... it’s a long story..."
Nux shook his head, for now, he just focused on what was important.
"That wasn’t her gift, it was us who misinterpreted it as one. Her third gift was something else, something...
Very useful."
The women frowned.
"Is it... a way to devour worlds without alerting the Infinities?"
Felberta asked with a ray of hope shining in her eyes but Nux—
He only grinned at those words.
"Without alerting them?
Oh Iamgoing to alert them.
I am going to alert them, I am going to let them surround me again and this time—
I am going to tear them apart."

chapters.title: Chapter 2394: Attack.
paragraphs: "Without alerting them?"
Nux laughed.
"Oh Iamgoing to alert them.
I am going to alert them, I am going to let them surround me again and this time—
I am going to tear them apart."
He spoke as his golden eyes shined intensely. The women frowned, they had no idea how he was going to do it, especially now when he was significantly weaker than before.

Nux smiled, he could tell what they were thinking, so now that he had charged himself, he stood up, Skyla and Lane rushed to support him, as if they were worried he would fall since his body was different than before.
He let them come, mostly out of wanting to touch them perversely than needing support, the girls obviously didn’t mind and once Nux had enough—
"Come with me."
He spoke.
"Where are we going?"
Amaya asked.
"Well, let me see."
Nux spoke as suddenly, a vast screen appeared in front of them. A screen that showed a beautiful endless forest of light where countless glowing branches stretched in every direction.
"This is..."
The Seer’s expression changed, she turned towards him with a shocked look on her face.
"How are you seeing it from... here?"
She asked.
And that made Nux chuckle.
"Where are we?"
He asked.
"Your Universe...?"
The Seer answered as if it was obvious.
"And where is my Universe?"
"What...?"
"Where is my Universe?"
Nux questioned and the Seer’s frown deepened.
"In the Multiverse..."
"So what exactly is surprising you?"
Nux grinned, the Seer however, shook her head at that as if it wasn’t possible.
"No, no, no.
This isn’t how it works.
No being inANYUniverse has the power to look through the Walls of a Universe and peek into the Multiverse—
That is not possible."
"You are right."
Nux agreed and that only confused the Seer even further.
"If you know that then how—"
But before she could complete her question—
"You said nobeing in any Universecan look through a Universe’s Walls.
Do you not see how that statement does not apply to me?"
Nux asked.
The Seer’s frown deepened even further, but then, as she gave it more thought, her expression changed.
"Youarea Universe..."
And Nux’s grin widened.
"Exactly."
He paused, his golden eyes shining brightly as he stared at the Multiverse in front of him.
"Iama Universe.
I am not looking through any Walls, I am merely looking at where my True Body is and am sharing that vision with all of you."
"No that..."
The Seer felt like what she was being told was wrong but... she couldn’t find any way to refute Nux’s words or prove him wrong.
Nux laughed at her flustered self. This was the first time he had seen her like this. It was... definitely enjoyable.
His wives, however, didn’t find it the least bit amusing.
In fact—
They had no clue what was happening.
What was it that they were seeing, what shocked the Seer so much, what exactly was this Multiverse they mentioned, they had no answer to any of these questions.
And—
They hated every second of it.
But just as they were about to ask Nux for answers, Nux turned to them and—
"I need your help."
He spoke and the moment they heard those words, it was like a switch was flipped.
How long had it been since Nux asked for their help?
How long had it been since they had been watching everything from the sidelines without being able to do anything at all?
But now that he was asking for something on his own—
All the questions they had in their heads no longer mattered and—
"What do you need?"
They asked.
And Nux...
He grinned.
"I want you to attack a few Universes for me."
"What...?"
The women frowned.
AfewUniverses...?
A few? As in... more than one...?
What...?
"Just wait for a bit."
Nux smiled.

Then, he looked back at the Multiverse, then at a specific Universe inside. This was the Universe where Ul’Thakar won. A Universe where death, darkness and despair reigned above all, a Universe where mortals were made to live lives full of agony just so that Darkness’s Authority could be strengthened, even when there was no need to actually strengthen it since Darkness already ruled it.
"This one seems good enough, doesn’t it?"
Nux commented.
The Seer, who could see what he was seeing, frowned.
"Nux, what are you trying to do?"
She asked with a worried look on her face. This Universe, because it was under one leader’s influence, was stronger than most Universes in the Multiverse and it worried her but—
"I said wait, didn’t I?"
Nux smiled.
A gaze was all he needed to understand that Universe’s Time Signature, then he turned towards the Seer again—
"Once you get the Time Signature, you align your time with it, correct?"
He asked.
And the Seer—
Although the answer to his question was a simple yes, for some reason, she couldn’t bring herself to say those words because she felt like the moment she said it, the moment she confirmed anything—
She would bring upon something inconceivable to the Multiverse.
But—
It was already too late.
She had already made the mistake of bringing Nux to the Multiverse, Nux already knew the answer to the question he just asked, she had told him herself.
Now—
Everything was in his hands.
And Nux—

He grinned, then with a wave of his hands, he moved trillions of trillions of beings in front of him, beings whose worlds he had used to rebuild his body, beings who were now forced inside the Four remaining Worlds and had waged war against each other and—
"Listen to me."
Nux spoke, his voice echoed through the crowd, silencing them in an instant.
"Your homes were taken away from you.
Now, it is time you take them back."
With another wave of his hands, hundreds of thousands of his own puppets appeared in the air.
"You shall go in and claim the worlds you see on your own.
If you do not—
Do not bother returning."
He gave the order.

The trillions of beings in front of him nodded, instantly aligning together. They already knew the drill beforehand, most of them had participated in the Main Universe raids before the Infinities found a way to stop them. Even those who didn’t already knew how it worked because the story had spread.
And honestly?
They had ALL been waiting for this particular moment.
To restart the raids, they just—
Didn’t expect the raids to be at this giant of a scale.
What they didn’t know, however, was the fact that this was just the beginning.
Nux grinned at that thought—
Then he looked at the Universe he had targeted, the Seer looked at him, almost fearful and a little hopeful of what he was going to do, Nux ignored her and—
He moved.

sentences.text: "Without alerting them?"
Nux laughed.
"Oh Iamgoing to alert them.
I am going to alert them, I am going to let them surround me again and this time—
I am going to tear them apart."
He spoke as his golden eyes shined intensely.
The women frowned, they had no idea how he was going to do it, especially now when he was significantly weaker than before.

Nux smiled, he could tell what they were thinking, so now that he had charged himself, he stood up, Skyla and Lane rushed to support him, as if they were worried he would fall since his body was different than before.
He let them come, mostly out of wanting to touch them perversely than needing support, the girls obviously didn’t mind and once Nux had enough—
"Come with me."
He spoke.
"Where are we going?"
Amaya asked.
"Well, let me see."
Nux spoke as suddenly, a vast screen appeared in front of them.
A screen that showed a beautiful endless forest of light where countless glowing branches stretched in every direction.
"This is..."
The Seer’s expression changed, she turned towards him with a shocked look on her face.
"How are you seeing it from... here?"
She asked.
And that made Nux chuckle.
"Where are we?"
He asked.
"Your Universe...?"
The Seer answered as if it was obvious.
"And where is my Universe?"
"What...?"
"Where is my Universe?"
Nux questioned and the Seer’s frown deepened.
"In the Multiverse..."
"So what exactly is surprising you?"
Nux grinned, the Seer however, shook her head at that as if it wasn’t possible.
"No, no, no.
This isn’t how it works.
No being inANYUniverse has the power to look through the Walls of a Universe and peek into the Multiverse—
That is not possible."
"You are right."
Nux agreed and that only confused the Seer even further.
"If you know that then how—"
But before she could complete her question—
"You said nobeing in any Universecan look through a Universe’s Walls.
Do you not see how that statement does not apply to me?"
Nux asked.
The Seer’s frown deepened even further, but then, as she gave it more thought, her expression changed.
"Youarea Universe..."
And Nux’s grin widened.
"Exactly."
He paused, his golden eyes shining brightly as he stared at the Multiverse in front of him.
"Iama Universe.
I am not looking through any Walls, I am merely looking at where my True Body is and am sharing that vision with all of you."
"No that..."
The Seer felt like what she was being told was wrong but... she couldn’t find any way to refute Nux’s words or prove him wrong.
Nux laughed at her flustered self.
This was the first time he had seen her like this.
It was... definitely enjoyable.
His wives, however, didn’t find it the least bit amusing.
In fact—
They had no clue what was happening.
What was it that they were seeing, what shocked the Seer so much, what exactly was this Multiverse they mentioned, they had no answer to any of these questions.
And—
They hated every second of it.
But just as they were about to ask Nux for answers, Nux turned to them and—
"I need your help."
He spoke and the moment they heard those words, it was like a switch was flipped.
How long had it been since Nux asked for their help?
How long had it been since they had been watching everything from the sidelines without being able to do anything at all?
But now that he was asking for something on his own—
All the questions they had in their heads no longer mattered and—
"What do you need?"
They asked.
And Nux...
He grinned.
"I want you to attack a few Universes for me."
"What...?"
The women frowned.
AfewUniverses...?
A few?
As in... more than one...?
What...?
"Just wait for a bit."
Nux smiled.
Then, he looked back at the Multiverse, then at a specific Universe inside.
This was the Universe where Ul’Thakar won.

A Universe where death, darkness and despair reigned above all, a Universe where mortals were made to live lives full of agony just so that Darkness’s Authority could be strengthened, even when there was no need to actually strengthen it since Darkness already ruled it.
"This one seems good enough, doesn’t it?"
Nux commented.
The Seer, who could see what he was seeing, frowned.
"Nux, what are you trying to do?"
She asked with a worried look on her face.
This Universe, because it was under one leader’s influence, was stronger than most Universes in the Multiverse and it worried her but—
"I said wait, didn’t I?"
Nux smiled.
A gaze was all he needed to understand that Universe’s Time Signature, then he turned towards the Seer again—
"Once you get the Time Signature, you align your time with it, correct?"
He asked.
And the Seer—
Although the answer to his question was a simple yes, for some reason, she couldn’t bring herself to say those words because she felt like the moment she said it, the moment she confirmed anything—
She would bring upon something inconceivable to the Multiverse.
But—
It was already too late.
She had already made the mistake of bringing Nux to the Multiverse, Nux already knew the answer to the question he just asked, she had told him herself.
Now—
Everything was in his hands.
And Nux—

He grinned, then with a wave of his hands, he moved trillions of trillions of beings in front of him, beings whose worlds he had used to rebuild his body, beings who were now forced inside the Four remaining Worlds and had waged war against each other and—
"Listen to me."
Nux spoke, his voice echoed through the crowd, silencing them in an instant.
"Your homes were taken away from you.
Now, it is time you take them back."
With another wave of his hands, hundreds of thousands of his own puppets appeared in the air.
"You shall go in and claim the worlds you see on your own.
If you do not—
Do not bother returning."
He gave the order.
The trillions of beings in front of him nodded, instantly aligning together.
They already knew the drill beforehand, most of them had participated in the Main Universe raids before the Infinities found a way to stop them.
Even those who didn’t already knew how it worked because the story had spread.
And honestly?
They had ALL been waiting for this particular moment.
To restart the raids, they just—
Didn’t expect the raids to be at this giant of a scale.
What they didn’t know, however, was the fact that this was just the beginning.
Nux grinned at that thought—
Then he looked at the Universe he had targeted, the Seer looked at him, almost fearful and a little hopeful of what he was going to do, Nux ignored her and—
He moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 2395: Invaders.
paragraphs: Nux looked at the Universe he had targeted, the Seer looked at him with a somewhat fearful look on her face, afraid of whatever it was he was going to do.
Nux ignored her and he—
He did something and the next instant—
The screen that was showing the Multiverse changed and showed somewhere else, somewhere the Seer recognized in an instant.
The Universe Nux was targeting.
But not at the point when it was at its strongest—

Nux had moved to the point in time where Ul’Thakar had just won the final War, a point in time where most of the Universe was destroyed, Ul’Thakar was injured to the point that he had to close himself off from the Universe and disappear for the next million years.

From this point onwards, the people of this Universe would have believed that Ul’Thakar too, had perished because of his grave injuries, that would have given rise to Seven new, independent Factions, who would then be at war to take control over the Universe.
A million years later, once Ul’Thakar returned, he would torture the leading figures of the Seven Factions and make the entire Universe witness it.
Then, he would take control over the Universe, dominate its Will and become the Absolute God of this Universe—
That was what wassupposed tohappen.
But—
"Nux, what happened? Why did it change?"
The Seer asked with a confused look on her face.
Nux looked at her with a frown.
"Hmm? Why are you suddenly asking the obvious?"
"Answer my question, Nux."
The Seer repeated in a stricter tone. She already knew the answer, she just... didn’t wish to believe it. Or maybe she just didn’t think it was even possible but—
"I explained it before, the screen shows what my Universe sees.
It shows where my Universe is."
"It is showing another Universe, Nux."
"That is because this is exactly where we are."
For a moment, the space turned silent. The Seer looked at Nux, then she looked around, at the Universe she was in—
"You aligned the Time of your entire Universe with this Universe’s Time Signature..."
"You are finally starting to get it."
"So your entire Universe became... an observer."
She commented in disbelief.
To think—
He would change the Time of his entire Universe to enter another Universe.
It was...
Well, at the very least, it wasn’t impossible in theory.
The Seer told herself, almost as if she was consoling herself that he hadn’t done something extremely out of the normal yet.
But the next instant—
"Oh, we aren’t here as a mere observer."
Nux corrected and the Seer froze.
"What... do you mean...?"
She asked.
Nux however, just looked at her and shrugged—
"I mean, what would I even do as a mere observer?"
The Seer didn’t know the answer to that, she, however, did have a question.
"Then... what are we here as...?"
She asked and the instant she did, Nux’s smile turned demonic.
"Invaders."
He answered and the next moment—
He gathered energy from the Four remaining Worlds and—
The Power of Anomaly moved around him.

At this point, Nux had not only fought against Zylarith, he had fought against five Infinities together, he died, then used the Power of Anomaly in a place where Energy didn’t even exist, then, he observed countless years for countless years and comprehended the Ultimate Power of Time—
That was Nux, that was what he had done—
And now that he was back at the place where he had nearly endless Energyandexperience—
With a mere thought, the Power of Anomaly moved and—
The Impossible happened.
He was here in this Universe as anObserver.
For him, interacting with the Universe was Impossible.
But—
Nux was the one whocontrolledthe Impossible. So with his understanding of the Law of Anomaly, which had now reached the highest level—
He made the Impossible Possible.
And he—
Instead of an Observer, became anInvader.
In an instant, more than a hundred thousand portals opened all at once in front of the army Nux had gathered.
And Nux—
"Go."
He ordered.
"Devour the World you see in front of you."
He had already opened the portals in a way where they led a particular Unit of the army with a particular strength in front of a world they had the capability to devour.
All his people had to do was enter through the portal Nux had created and attack.
That was it.
And that was exactly what his army did.
In an instant—
About tens of thousands of beings invaded a single world, prepared to devour it and—
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe that had been recovering from a major War, the Universe that was already wounded, the Universe that was expecting some rest now that the strongest being inside it had closed itself off—
Suddenly trembled in shock and absolute rage as more than a hundred thousand of its worlds were attacked and disappeared.
Devoured by a being it didn’t know anything about.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe was enraged, so much that, in its rage, in order to get the unknown invader who took advantage of its weakest moment and then hid away—
It decided to self-destruct.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER

The very void shook, the stars all over the Universe turned red, every single world in the Universe felt it. The existing Laws began to reverse, Creation turned against matter, Space started folding inward, Time shook and then cracked.
Stars collapsed, the remaining Worlds that Nux’s army did not attack split apart on their own.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe roared one last time, this time, louder than ever.
Its rage and hatred couldn’t be more obvious.
Ul’Thakar, despite being injured, tried to rush out and stop what was happening the moment he realized the grave danger.
But—
It was already too late.
The Universe burned its very Core and with that—
The entire Universe exploded, taking its worlds, its stars, its other cosmic entities, even its remaining Infinity with it.
As for the enemy who had attacked it, the army that devoured its worlds, the reason behind the massive destruction—
They had disappeared long before the self-destruction began.
The Universe’s destruction didn’t harm anyone but the Universe itself.
And Nux, who was watching it all, only had one thing to say—
"Damn."

chapters.title: Chapter 2396: Another way.
paragraphs: "Damn."
Nux stood inside his Universe and watched the entire Universe, that was supposed to live for the next few hundred quintillion years, collapse in front of him.
The destruction did not reach Nux or his army. The moment his forces had finished devouring the worlds he needed, he had already pulled them back but even then—
Watching it happen was... not easy.
A Universe was not supposed to die like this, not while it still had so much life left in it.
Nux stared at the collapse in silence. He didn’t show anything on his face, but even he felt the weight of it.
But the one who felt this weight even more was...
The Seer.

She had watched countless Universes for countless years, her mind was older than almost every Universe in the Multiverse, to her, the death of a Universe wasn’t a surprising or overwhelming incident, she had seen countless Universes die.
But—
This was different.
This was... unnatural.
This... wasn’tsupposed to have happened.
And the worst part?
She was a part of it, her actions had helped it happen and as that realization sunk in, as she stared at the collapsing Universe, for the first time in her long life—
She looked... shaken.
"You... You destroyed it..."
She muttered weakly.
Nux did not look away from the dying Universe.
"That was not my intention."
He answered honestly.
"Not your intention?"
She slowly turned towards him.
"You devoured more than a hundred thousand worlds, Nux.
What did you expect to happen?"
Nux remained silent for a moment, then—
"I did not have a choice."
The Seer stared at him, waiting for a clearer explanation and Nux gave it to her.
"My Universe was dying."
He spoke as he finally turned toward her.
"You know what I am."
"A Universe."
She answered.
"Yes. My true body was my Universe."
Nux nodded as he looked down at his own hand, athisnew body which was... different from what it used to be.
"When I erased my connection with my Universe, I abandoned my true body. It was the only way for my wives and my children to survive my death."
Nux spoke as he looked at his wives, who narrowed their eyes, listening intensely.
"But when I came back, I could not simply reconnect with my Universe and return to the way things were."
"Why?"
The Seer asked and Nux’s eyes darkened as he thought about it.
"Because the price would have been too high."
He paused for a moment, as if collecting his thoughts before he began explaining.
"If I had tried to fully reform my connection with my Universe and reclaim it as my true body, the worlds I devoured wouldn’t have been enough, I would have needed more."
I would have needed to devour the foundation of my own Universe, its Laws, its structure, its existence..."
His eyes moved towards his wives and—
"And its people."
He revealed.
"My wives, my children, everything I wanted to protect, to reclaim my old body, I needed to devour them all."
He spoke, hating the very idea of what he just said.
And the Seer—
She understood it.
"You would have created a new Universe from the remains of the old one, with new Laws, with new... people."
"Yes."
Nux nodded.
"But you refused."
She spoke carefully.
"And you refused."
"Of course I refused."
Nux answered as if it was obvious.
"I did not come back to replace them.
I came backforthem."
He declared, then after a momentary silence.
"So I chose another way."
"You created this body.
A... smaller vessel."
The Seer commented, looking at Nux’s current self.
"Yes."
The Seer looked at him from head to toe, her mind moved quickly. Nux could practically see her thoughts connecting, then her expression changed.
"But that should not be possible."
"It usually is not."
Nux smiled faintly.
"No matter how much you weaken yourself, you would still be a Universe-level existence and...
One Universe cannot support another Universe inside it.
So when you created a vessel inside your own Universe, a vessel that may be weaker but still carries the weight of your existence—
It made your Universe unstable."
She realized, soon however, she frowned at her own words as if something didn’t add up.
"No, your Universe is no different than a newborn, it wouldn’t just beunstable, it shouldn’t even survive. It should have collapsed.
You..."
Suddenly, the Seer’s expression changed even further.
"You were using the Power of Anomaly to forcefully hold its existence together all this while!"
"Yes."
Nux admitted.
The Seer’s mind moved even quicker as she began solving the equation.
"But you needed the Power of Anomaly to open those portals as well."
She frowned.
Nux nodded.
"That was the issue.
My Universe was already unstable, opening portals to more than a hundred thousand Worlds inside another Universe made it even worse."
"But you still did it."
The Seer commented, then, she finally realized it.
"You knew your Universe could survive a few seconds of instability, that is all you had—
So you dropped everything and created as many portals as you could, sent your army and devoured as many worlds as possible because—
That was all you could do.
This was... your only chance.
Only chance to strengthen your Universe enough to be able to hold your existence without collapsing."
"Indeed."
Nux nodded, his eyes didn’t reflect any emotion.
The Seer looked at him, then at the Universe behind him and—
"That means your current existence is divided.
One is your Universe and the other is... this new body you created.

From now on, only strengthening your Universe would no longer strengthen you, you would need to strengthen your new body separately and while you do that, you also need to ensure that your Universe is strengthened enough to hold your body’s existence."
Nux just nodded again, there was not much he needed to add. The Seer understood almost all of it. It was almost terrifying how intelligent she was.
"So the hundred thousand worlds you just devoured didn’t actually strengthen you, it only strengthened your Universe enough to hold your existence."
"That sounds more dramatic than I would put it, but yes."
Nux laughed.
And as his wives saw him interact with the Seer, they narrowed their eyes.

From now on, only strengthening your Universe would no longer strengthen you, you would need to strengthen your new body separately and while you do that, you also need to ensure that your Universe is strengthened enough to hold your body’s existence."
Nux just nodded again, there was not much he needed to add.
The Seer understood almost all of it.
It was almost terrifying how intelligent she was.
"So the hundred thousand worlds you just devoured didn’t actually strengthen you, it only strengthened your Universe enough to hold your existence."
"That sounds more dramatic than I would put it, but yes."
Nux laughed.
And as his wives saw him interact with the Seer, they narrowed their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2397: Hmm, that one seems good.
paragraphs: "That sounds more dramatic than I would put it, but yes."
Nux laughed and as his wives, especially Shadow, saw him interact with the Seer, she narrowed her eyes.
Shadow did not know any of what was being discussed and... that made her feel uncomfortable.
Till now, her understanding of Nux’s Universe had only been weaker than Nux himself, she knew things no other being other than Nux knew but now...
Now as she looked at Nux and the Seer talking about things that made absolutely no sense in her mind, she felt... threatened.
As the first Goddess of the Universe, she was supposed to know everything but she didn’t even know their Universe was near collapse.
She didn’t know what Nux had been doing all this while, neither did she know how he did what he did.

She only felt their Universe strengthening when Nux devoured all those worlds and while she did wonder why it wasn’t strengthened as much as she thought it would since a hundred thousand was an absurd number, in her mind, that didn’t matter since it was busy trying to comprehend what Nux and the Seer were talking about.
Shadow...
She felt like an outsider inside her own Universe.
As she looked at the Seer, she couldn’t help but think that... she knew more about Nux’s Universe than her and it... angered her.
And it wasn’t just her.

As the women watched her converse with Nux, as they sensed how familiar they had become, how the dynamic between them had changed from Nux always being the one who guessed her intentions to her asking questions with shocked, even terrified looks on her face.
The women did not like that one bit—
Because that change of dynamic was... similar to theirs.
The Seer...
She was becoming one of them.
And the worst part?
Both of them did not seem to realize it.
"Heh."
Allura grinned, her eyes shining with a mischievous look, but before she could say or even think of doing anything—
"Don’t."
Amaya spoke with a strict look on her face.
"Do not forget what she did."
She spoke as she looked at the Seer with hatred.
Allura looked at her, then at the Seer, then at Nux talking to her—
"He seems to have forgiven her."
She smiled.
Amaya didn’t say anything.
She still felt... uncomfortable.
But then—
"Calm down."
Riona gently held her hand. Amaya turned to her mother and Riona smiled—
"Nux is not foolish, Amaya.
If he has decided to trust anyone, we can trust her as well."
"I still need the full story."
Amaya wasn’t convinced.
"It’s not just you who wants it."
Felberta spoke, her eyes staring at the Seer with curious eyes. Skyla, Aisha and Eisheth had a familiar shine in their eyes as well.
The Seer, oblivious to their conversation, was entirely focused on Nux.
"So what now?"
She asked.
"Hmm? What do you mean?"
Nux tilted his head in confusion and the Seer, she just blinked.

"You destroyed a Universe that should have lived for three hundred quintillion more years, from this point on, it was supposed to birth a hundred and fifteen more branches, branches which would further give birth to thousands of branches.
Your single action has put the survival of thousands of Universes in jeopardy, what are you going to do about it?"
The Seer asked.
And Nux just looked at her with a smile.
"Do you remember when I asked what you were going to do after you used me as a veil and interacted with the Universe when you shouldn’t?"
He asked and the instant he did, the Seer’s expression changed because she remembered her answer.
"You are going to leave it to the Multiverse..."
"That’s the Multiverse’s mess to deal with."
Nux shrugged, repeating the Seer’s exact words.
The Seer didn’t know what to say, she couldn’t even get mad because she had done the exact same thing.
But—
The difference between the two of them was that—
Nux wasn’t planning on stopping.
"Nux."
Suddenly, Vyriana called as she walked towards him, behind her were Ember and Astaria.
"Hm?"
Nux turned towards them and smiled.
He seemed much calmer now that he didn’t have to forcefully hold his Universe’s existence together.
"You didn’t send us in."
Astaria complained.
"I couldn’t possibly have sent any of you when it was my first time doing what I did. I didn’t know how this would have played out."
"You said you needed our help."
Ember narrowed her eyes.
"I do.
Right now."
Nux nodded.
Then, he turned back towards the screen where the Multiverse was now visible and the moment the Seer looked at Nux’s face, her eyes widened in horror as the realization finally set in.
Nux wasn’t done.
And he wasn’t.
"Hmm, that one seems good."

He muttered as he pointed at another Universe, a Universe where Seraphielle had won and unlike how most would expect—where she, even if it was just to improve her Authority with the Power of Light, would promote peace and happiness—
It didn’t happen.
In fact, Seraphielle did the opposite.
Now, when she realized she had won and no being was strong enough to challenge her, she let go of the persona she had built and let her rotten personality come out.

The Universe screamed, the forces of Light suppressed anyone who dared raise their voice, taxes were introduced just so every being barely scraped by, but at the same time, Seraphielle didn’t kill anyone either.
She erased the concept of death so suffering could continue for Eternity.
The Universe was... rotten to the Core.
Nux couldn’t help but feel disgusted by it, not that he cared, he simply chose the weakest point of the Universe’s Timeline.

It was the same too, right after Seraphielle’s victory, the only difference was that Seraphielle didn’t close herself off, she was injured but she simply sacrificed a few worlds to gather enough energy to be able to heal herself.
Although that didn’t change anything either.
Nux had been attacking the Main Universe when all Four Infinities were at their strongest, so as long as he didn’t attack the Universe after an Infinity had become its Absolute God—
He wouldn’t face any problem.
So he did exactly that.
He chose the exact time where Seraphielle had just won the War, before she could even heal herself let alone take over the Universe—
And—
HeInvaded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2398: Should I... take my revenge...?
paragraphs: And it began.
Nux did not stop after two Universes.
How could he?
His Universe may be stable now, but his body was ridiculously weaker than before, so much that let alone an Infinity, even an Eternal could defeat him.
He needed to grow.
And to grow, he needed to devour more Worlds.
The good news, however, was that he no longer needed to rely on just one Universe to get the resources he needed.
No.
Now he had the entire Multiverse in front of him.
Quindecillions of Universes andmore.
And Nux was fully planning to use this endless source of resources to his fullest advantage.
With that thought in his mind—
He moved.

He opened portals into other Universes, but this time, he was careful not to make the same mistake. He didn’t target hundreds of thousands of Worlds at the same time, he didn’t want other Universes self-destructing because of him, that would cause too much chaos in the Multiverse, chaos that even the Multiverse wouldn’t be able to handle.
So he changed his method.
From each Universe, he took only a little.
Ten worlds.
Twenty.
Fifty.
Sometimes even a hundred, if the Universe was large enough to survive the loss without shaking too much.
Never more.
He made sure that his attacks only made the Universe’s Will feel threatened, enraged, or filled it with hatred, but he never pushed it further into madness.
It was still something no normal being could even imagine—
But compared to the size of a Universe, it was... more like a cut than a beheading.
His armies moved fast.

The moment portals opened, the soldiers entered, took the preselected worlds, worlds Nux believed would probably make the particular Universe more liveable if they did not exist, worlds that usually housed the most corrupt but influential personalities in the Universe at that particular time.
Once the target was achieved, the soldiers retreated and the portal closed while the Universe rumbled in anger.
Then—

Nux opened another portal, to another Universe, soon however, he made a little change in his tactics, he stopped targeting the Universe when it was at its weakest, this was the time when the Universe was at its most vulnerable, the chances of it overreacting and choosing to self-destruct were the highest.
And since Infinities’ involvement never really mattered—
Nux basically started attacking at random times, only actively avoiding times when the Universe had a God.
And just like that—
Nux’s attacks continued.
Again.
And again.
And again.
His wives participated in the raids as well, every single one of them commanded a different Unit.
And as they attacked—
Nux’s body had been weakened to such an extreme degree after everything it had been through—
It started growing stronger again.
At first, it carried the strength of only a few worlds.
Then—
The number rose to two digits.
Then three.
Then four.
Until eventually—
It rose to millions.
Tens of millions.
Hundreds of millions.
Yes, near the very end, Nux’s physical body carried the strength of more than a few hundred million worlds.
He had become far, far, far stronger than the time he was facing the five Infinities in the so-called Main Universe.
At this point, even the word "durable" had become too weak.
His body was nearly indestructible.
After all, harming him was no different than trying to cut through hundreds of millions of worlds at once.
How many beings in the entire Multiverse could do that?
Nux didn’t know any.
And it wasn’t just his physical body that grew, after all, he still needed to make sure his Universe was strong enough to hold his existence.
So every resource he used on his body, greater resources were sent into his Universe.

His Universe became brighter, denser and far stronger. Trillions of worlds now existed within it, he prepared a few for his people to deal with the problem of overcrowding, some were left aside for his children, but most of them becameStars.
Worlds that had but one purpose, to act as engines of power, to give Nux a nearly endless amount of Energy.
And with that—
The instability faded.
The... ’cracks’ in his Universe closed.
The moment where it felt like the Universe might collapse any time now seemed distant.
But Nux’s greed didn’t rest there.
The stronger he got, the more difficult to defeat he became, the greedier he became. Now he no longer cared about just his Physical Body or the amount of Energy stored inside his Universe.
Now—
He started targetingQuality of Energyand Knowledge.
The Multiverse was absurdly large.
So large that the Five Infinities he knew—
Infinity Of Light.
Infinity Of Darkness.
Infinity Of Balance.
Infinity Of Chaos.
Infinity Of Eternity.
These weren’t the only Infinities in existence.
In branch Universes where these Infinities killed each other, new Infinities were born.
Infinity of Time.
Infinity Of Space.
Infinity Of Creation.
Infinity Of Destruction.
Infinity Of Life.
Infinity Of Death.
Infinities of Laws that the Universe he was originally from had never produced.
These were the beings who ruled their Universes as Absolutes, beings who were worshiped as Gods of their realities, beings who had never known defeat—
That was until Nux appeared and...
Overpowered them like they were mere Ants.
But—
Nux did not devour them.
He did not wish to remove Infinity-Level Beings from the Multiverse, so he simply defeated them, read their memories, and learned what they knew.
He saw how the Infinity of Time understood Time.
He saw how the Infinity of Space understood Space.
He saw how the Infinity of Death understood Death.
He saw how the Infinity of Life understood Life.
He saw how the Infinity of Creation understood Creation.
He saw how the Infinity of Destruction understood Destruction.
Yes—
He raised his understanding of ALL ten Primordial Energies to the Level of Infinities.
And with that—
As his understanding of Energies, as his understanding of the Universes, his understanding of the Multiverse—
His understanding of the verySystemimproved.
His understanding of how toEscape this Systemfollowed.
His Law of Anomaly changed as well.
It had already gotten much, much, much stronger after spending an unknown amount of years in the Multiverse, but now—
It wasComplete.
He understood that the Law of Anomaly wasn’t just the poweroutside of rules, it was the authority to movewhere rules ended.
To act where logic failed.
To exist where existence had no answer.
To make the impossible not just happen—
But become natural after it happened.
That was Nux Leander.
The very definition of impossibility.
A being even the Multiverse had no proper word for.
A Universe that could walk into other Universes.
A body made from hundreds of millions of worlds.
A foundation supported by trillions of world-stars.
A mind carrying Infinity-level understanding of all Primordial Energies.
A being with complete understanding of Impossibility.
And as this being stood in his own Universe, looking at his own hands, feeling the strength of hundreds of millions of worlds in his body, he looked at the endless Multiverse in front of him—
Then at his wives—
Who he had sent to sleep because he knew it would have taken a long time.
"Should I... take my revenge...?"
He asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2399: Don’t think too much about it~
paragraphs: Nux’s wives woke up one after another with frowns on their faces.
The last thing they remembered was returning from one of the Universes they attacked for Nux, Nux standing before them with that same, soft smile and telling them to rest now that he was fine.

They tried to resist, mostly because they did not like leaving the Seer beside him one bit, but Nux just smiled, then suddenly, they felt heavy and since the last few hours they spent had been especially heavy on them—
They couldn’t argue and passed out.
Nux teleported them to their bed, then, he froze the time around them, just like he did around his children.
And now—
When they opened their eyes after what felt like a few hours to them, they noticed him standing in front of them with that same, usual smile on his face and they—
They felt it.
The difference.
The body that could barely move had disappeared.
This was... far too different.
Felberta was the first to sit up, her eyes blinking without stop as she looked at Nux.
"Are you... okay now?"
She asked.
Nux laughed at that.
The Seer standing beside him had no idea what she was supposed to say. Amaya didn’t fail to notice that, she also narrowed her eyes at how closely the bitch was standing next to him.
"What did you do?"
Vyriana narrowed her eyes and asked directly. As a being who had the Law of Absolute Strength, she could literallyfeelthe absurd change and it overwhelmed her mind in a way it never had before.
Not even when she was in the presence of Azriel, or other Infinities.
"How much time has passed?"
Astaria asked.
"Don’t worry about it."
Nux waved his hand, dismissing her.
"Our children aren’t even awake yet."
He laughed.
Then, before the wives could ask anything—
"Anyways."
Nux gained their attention with just a mere word.
"I was thinking...
Should I take my revenge?"
"Your revenge...?"
Aeliana blinked and Nux’s grin just widened even further—
"Well, on the records—
Theydidwin.
I can’t have that, now can I?
The Multiverse would laugh at me for losing to those weaklings."
"Weaklings...?"
The Vampire didn’t know what she was supposed to say.
Nux chuckled.
"Just give me a few minutes, would you?
You see, I can’tperformthe best knowing that I have a stain on my record. So give me a few minutes, let me go and fix the stain real quick and once I am back—"
Nux’s smile turned perverted and—
"We’ll play."
His eyes shined with a playful light, then, he disappeared, leaving the Seer together with the confused wives.
A position the Seer would rather not be in right now.
"I have been awake for a while now, I shall go get some rest."
The Seer spoke, trying to leave but—
"Stop right there."
Amaya spoke up with a strict tone and the Seer froze where she was.
"Come back."
Amaya commanded, the Seer hesitated for a moment, but in the end, she just took a deep breath and turned around.
"Do you need something?"
"Stop trying to act smart, you know what we need."
Amaya spoke, at this point, Skyla had already grabbed the Seer’s hand, or at least she tried to, but her hand passed right through hers.
That made her frown, for now, however, she didn’t care about it, she just asked the Seer to sit on the bed with them, the Seer, having no choice, followed.
The women surrounded her the next instant, she looked at them carefully and then she turned back towards Amaya and—
"I truly do not know what you need."
She answered.
Amaya felt her mouth twitch, she however, swallowed her anger, just asked directly.
"What happened to Nux after the Infinities killed him, I want you to tell us everything."
The Seer looked at her, then the rest of the women who looked at her with strong curiosity.
"Why not ask him?"
She asked.
"Then we would have nothing to talk to you about now, would we?"
Eisheth chuckled.
"Why would you want to talk to me?"
The Seer frowned.
"You do not want to?"
Allura tilted her head.
"Well, I do not deny wishing for friends to talk to."
"Then what’s the issue?"
Allura smiled.
The Seer noticed that smile, then her expression changed as she looked at the rest of the women.
"You...
You believe I would fall for Nux and become one of you."
She finally realized it.
"Took you long enough."
Aisha laughed.
The Seer however, just chuckled as she shook her head.
"You misunderstood.
The two of us have a deal, I wanted something from him, that is the only reason I am here in the first place."
"Riiighttt."
Allura nodded.
"You do not believe me."
"Oh, I am sure you believe what you just said."
"But you still do not believe me."
"Well...
We have seen it happen quite a few times."
Allura shrugged, trying to make her case.
And for a moment, the Seer turned silent.

She looked at the women sitting in front of her, she recalled their lives before they met Nux. As someone who thoroughly looked into Nux, she obviously looked into his wives as well, she knew everything there was to know about these women, she knew what position they were in before meeting Nux and more importantly—
She knew how their lives changed after they met Nux and for a moment, she began to... consider it.
She had been... lonely for countless years.
She has had no one to talk to, who could she talk to, any being she met before her, she knew of their past, their present, and their future, she knew things they hid from the rest of the world.
She couldn’t interact with them, she couldn’t even touch them, there was... absolutely no common ground.
Of course, because of all she knew, she could easily initiate a conversation if she wanted to, she could even make any man or woman fall for her but...
She could never be... her real self.
No being could match her intelligence, they couldn’t keep up with her, they couldn’t hold actual conversations that she wanted to hold and that had created a void.
A void that had become so strong after living alone for quindecillions of years that... the thought of filling it didn’t even come to her mind.
But...
Nux was different.
Not only did he understand what she knew, he was intelligent enough to keep up with her, they could have a conversation on any topic they wanted without getting bored, and the best part?
She had no clue what his future was going to be like because Nux Leander’s future was never written in the first place.
That meant their conversations would be more natural, she wouldn’t have to say what she wanted him to hear, she could say what she actually wanted—
She could be her... real self.
And the more the Seer thought about it—
The more... believable the idea became.
It... it didn’t seem like a bad decision.
And the moment she thought about it, the moment her expression showed that slightest little change, Allura grinned, knowing exactly what that look meant.
For now, however, she didn’t overwhelm her, instead, she...preparedher for what was about to come.
Slowly.
Without her realizing.
"Don’t think too much about it~"
She began by dismissing her current thoughts.
"You start with what we initially asked—
What happened to Nux when those five did what they did? And what did you think about him when you met him the first time?"
The Succubus asked and even though the Seer knew how she was trying to push her into the trap, she let herself be pushed willingly and—
"When he died, I..."
She began her story.
While the Seer and Nux’s wives were having their own conversation, Nux, who was looking at the Multiverse, now searched for a specific Universe.
The Universe where it all began.
It didn’t take him long, with how many times he had used it at this point, searching through the forest of Universes came naturally to him.
He looked at the Timeline that had become a mess because of his presence, a Timeline that was trying to fix itself—
Then, he looked for a particular moment.
The moment when Orravyn’s relics captured him, when the other Infinities made escape impossible, and then the moment where—
They erased him.
And once he found that exact moment—
He grinned.
His Golden Eyes shined and—
He stepped forward.
He invaded the Universe, only this time, he didn’t bring an army—
He went alone.
To complete the battle and wipe the only stain on his record.
